items.title: 〈台股盤前要聞〉電價續凍漲、外資期現貨做多買超第五大
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Pre‑Market News: Electricity Prices Remain Frozen, Foreign Investors Lead Futures and Spot Buying to 5th Largest Net Purchase
paras:
台股盤前要聞 

1.經濟部18日召開2026年第2次電價費率審議會，會後記者會由次長賴建信主持。審議委員會指出，影響本期電價的主因為中東戰事，國際燃料價格大漲導致發購電成本大幅攀升，為避免引發國內物價波動，會議決議支持優先爭取政府撥補預算711億元，因此本次電價調整暫不決定，留待今年12月併入第3次電價審議會審議輸配電費率時再行討論，意味著最快調漲電價的時間點將落在明年1月。
2.台北股市18日在各不確定性消除之後，大盤終場以上漲892.75點收盤，報47180.75點，成交值逾1.07兆元，龐大量能潮補足昨日未能站穩4700點遺憾。外資在期貨、現貨同步做多，買超869.94億元創台股中第5大買超，加碼個股以記憶體族群為主。儘管外資連續2日買超共991.79億元，全周仍賣超184.64億元。
3. 上海航運交易所18日公布最新上海出口集裝箱運價指數，綜合指數較前一期上漲25.65點至3687.83點，漲幅約0.7%，已連續第八周上漲；其中美東、美西線也持續走強。
4. LED大廠富采(3714-TW)18日代子公司富采光電公告自3/9-3/18期間，依市場價格取得關係人友達(2409-TW)普通股股票共計73128張，每股平均價格為20.48元，交易總金額約達14.98億元。本次交易完成後，富采累計持有友達持股比例達0.97%，主要目的在於增進集團策略協同效益，發揮永動機策略結盟綜效，並持續擴大集團在高附加價值應用的市場版圖。
5. 仁寶(2324-TW)18日與鋐寶分別召開董事會，並於晚間召開重訊記者會，通過以現金為對價的股份轉換案，此次股份轉換對價為每股18.5元，股份轉換完成後，鋐寶將成為仁寶100%持股子公司。

paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs held the second 2026 electricity tariff review meeting on the 18th, with Deputy Minister Lai Chien‑hsin chairing the post‑meeting press conference. The review committee said the main factor affecting the current electricity price is the Middle‑East conflict, which has driven international fuel prices sharply higher and pushed power‑generation costs up dramatically. To avoid domestic price volatility, the meeting resolved to prioritize securing a government subsidy of NT$71.1 billion, so the tariff adjustment will not be decided now and will be deferred to the third tariff review in December when transmission and distribution rates are examined. This means the earliest possible price hike would be in January 2027.

On the 18th, after various uncertainties cleared, the Taipei stock market closed up 892.75 points at 47,180.75, with a turnover exceeding NT$1.07 trillion, recouping the missed 4,700‑point level from the previous day. Foreign investors bought net NT$86.994 billion in both futures and spot markets, ranking as the fifth‑largest net purchase in Taiwan equities, focusing mainly on memory‑chip stocks. Although foreign investors posted net purchases for two consecutive days totaling NT$99.179 billion, they still recorded a net sell of NT$18.464 billion for the week.

The Shanghai Shipping Exchange released its latest Shanghai Export Container Freight Index on the 18th. The composite index rose 25.65 points to 3,687.83, an increase of about 0.7%, marking the eighth consecutive week of gains. The East‑Coast US and West‑Coast US routes also continued to strengthen.

LED giant Foxconn (3714‑TW) announced on the 18th, via its subsidiary Foxconn Optoelectronics, that it purchased 73,128 shares of related party AU Optronics (2409‑TW) at an average price of NT$20.48 per share between March 9 and March 18, for a total transaction value of approximately NT$1.498 billion. After the deal, Foxconn’s cumulative stake in AU Optronics reaches 0.97%. The acquisition aims to enhance group strategic synergies, leverage the “perpetual motion” alliance effect, and further expand the group’s footprint in high‑value‑added applications.

Wistron (2324‑TW) held board meetings with Honbo on the 18th and later held a press conference, approving a cash‑for‑stock swap at NT$18.5 per share. Upon completion, Honbo will become a wholly‑owned subsidiary of Wistron, deepening its Edge‑AI strategy.
Electricity prices remain frozen as the review panel voted to prioritize securing a NT$71.1 billion government subsidy, with tariff rates postponed for combined review in December.
Foreign investors aggressively bought futures and spot stocks, netting NT$86.9 billion—the fifth‑largest net purchase on record—while still posting a net sell of NT$18.4 billion for the week.

Foxconn’s acquisition of 73,128 AU Optronics shares deepens the group’s “3+1” strategic alliance synergy.
Wistron’s cash payment of NT$18.5 per share to acquire Honbo’s entire equity strengthens its Edge‑AI positioning.
<Apple New Release> The iPhone 18 Pro series hits the market, with the three major telecom carriers deploying different pricing strategies to attract customers.
The three AI giants call for a slowdown, yet Wistron’s Lin Hsien‑ming and Pegatron’s Tong Tzu‑hsien remain optimistic about the AI industry.
Shengda Technology’s August revenue reached NT$321 million, a new high for the period, with analysts forecasting strong earnings growth before year‑end.
200 GB PD mass production eases material shortages, and Uni‑World KY’s Q3 results are expected to warm up quarter by quarter.
Wah Hsing Light’s new product line is projected to scale up in the second half of 2027, with institutional investors estimating that capacity expansion could trigger rapid growth.
Biomedical and drone sectors see major upgrades: Taiwan‑Kang Sheng, Ju‑Yang, Cai‑Yu, and Patriot Green Energy have all been approved for the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ A+ program.

items.title: Fed卡什卡里：通膨壓力已擴散至美經濟所有領域
items.title_en: Fed's Kashkari: Inflation Pressure Has Spread to All Areas of the U.S. Economy
paras: 美國明尼阿波利斯聯準銀行總裁卡什卡里(Neel Kashkari)周日(20日)表示，美國通膨仍過高，壓力已經超出美伊戰爭導致的油價衝擊，擴散至經濟多個領域。美國人每天感受到的通膨遠不只是油價問題，而是存在於經濟各個層面。
卡什卡里表示，聯準會(Fed)日益擔心通膨並非只集中在受中東衝突或關稅影響的領域，服務業也出現通膨跡象。他並指出，Fed職責是讓通膨回到目標水平，並擁有實現這一目標的工具。
卡什卡里先前是7月維持利率不變決定中的三名反對者之一，當時他傾向於升息，並警告等待時間過長恐導致通膨固化，最終需要採取更激進措施。
卡什卡里認為，美國經濟儘管面臨地緣衝突和貿易問題，仍展現較強韌性，勞動市場維持強勁。他希望隨著部分衝突影響逐漸消退，經濟成長能夠接替推動作用，通膨降溫進程加快，進而降低Fed政策壓力。
paras_en: U.S. Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari said on Sunday (the 20th) that inflation in the United States remains too high, with pressure now exceeding the oil‑price shock caused by the U.S.–Iran conflict and spreading across multiple sectors of the economy. Americans feel inflation every day not just as a fuel‑price issue but as a factor present throughout the economy.

Kashkari noted that the Fed is increasingly worried that inflation is not confined to areas affected by Middle‑East tensions or tariffs, as signs of inflation are also appearing in the services sector. He added that the Fed’s job is to bring inflation back to its target level and that it has the tools to achieve that goal.

Kashkari was previously one of three dissenters in the July decision to keep rates unchanged, favoring a rate hike and warning that waiting too long could allow inflation to become entrenched, eventually requiring more aggressive action.

Kashkari believes that despite geopolitical conflicts and trade issues, the U.S. economy remains relatively resilient, with a strong labor market. He hopes that as the impact of some conflicts wanes, economic growth can take over as the driving force, accelerating the cooling of inflation and thereby easing policy pressure on the Fed.

items.title: 〈走進中國〉在讀75.36萬 存量120萬 中國博士真的過剩了嗎？
items.title_en: Are China’s PhDs Really Oversupplied? 750,000 Enrolled, 1.2 Million Graduates
paras: 2026年6月，在中國一所「211」大學的畢業典禮上，戲劇影視學博士生彭靜萍（化名）從輔導員口中得知一組數據：今年同專業畢業的20多名同學中，真正落實工作的僅兩人；若將「已拿到錄取通知但尚未簽約」的情況也計算在內，總數勉強達到五人。
其餘同學的情況各不相同：有人在招聘平台上投出三個月簡歷仍無著落，有人已返回老家待業，還有人幾經輾轉，最終又簽回讀博前工作單位。
個體的背後，是一個規模持續擴張的群體。數據顯示，2025年全中國共招收研究生143.85萬人，其中博士生20.16萬人、碩士生123.68萬人；博士生招生較2024年增加17.8%；碩士生招生首次突破120萬人，畢業碩士生首次突破100萬人；全國在學研究生達429.95萬人，各種形式高等教育在學總規模達4,872.57萬人，均創歷史新高。
把時間軸拉長，擴張軌跡更加清晰。教育部歷年統計公報顯示，博士招生規模從2015年的7.44萬人增至2025年的20.16萬人，十年間擴大至約2.7倍；在學博士生從2016年的34.2萬人增至75.36萬人，增長約1.2倍；畢業博士生從2016年的5.5萬人增至11.29萬人，翻了一番有餘。
放在更長歷史坐標中，如今規模更顯驚人。1983年5月27日，新中國首批18名博士在人民大會堂接受學位授予。2008年1月，國務院學位委員會的數據顯示，改革開放29年間全國累計授予博士學位24萬人——如今，博士一年招生20.16萬人，接近當年29年累計總數八成。
《財經》雜誌指出，部分博士暫時沒找到工作，不等於博士群體過剩。
廈門大學教育研究院教授陳興德強調，博士佔總人口比重反映長期積累，招生規模反映未來供給，就業情況反映人才與崗位的關係，三者不能相互替代——「討論就業壓力，應當關注畢業生規模及其變化，不能把75萬在學博士都當作同一年進入就業市場的人。」
博士「過剩論」最直接的依據來自學術賽道。《自然》雜誌曾刊文《世界需要多少博士？博士畢業生的數量遠遠超過學術界工作崗位》，指出過去幾十年來，全球博士畢業生規模穩步擴大，但大量博士生面臨學術崗位供給不足的問題，研究機構難以全部容納，僧多粥少的局面引發學界擔憂。
長期以來，在博士學位的學術光環之下，大學培養學生、學生選擇讀博，指向的都是同一個目標——成為學術研究者。
香港大學高等教育政策與實踐研究員雨果·奧爾塔（Hugo Horta）指出，「大多數進入博士項目的學生，接受的培養仍是以成為學者為目標，因此未來許多畢業生在競爭任何學術崗位時，都會面臨激烈競爭。」
奧爾塔指出的是全球博士教育的普遍狀況，這種期待與現實的落差，在中國同樣存在。華東師範大學高等教育研究所所長閻光才援引2022年一項對2,300名在讀博士生的調查，稱約六成博士生期待在大學工作，人文社科領域的比例高達75%至80%。
教育部2023年12月公布的數據是，當年應屆博士畢業生中，實際進入大學和科研機構的僅約四成。
學術賽道的擁擠並非中國獨有。韓國國家統計門戶網站（KOSIS）發布的《2025年國內新增博士學位獲得者調查》顯示，在1.0498萬名新增博士中，未就業者佔33.3%，寫下2014年該項統計開始以來最高值；其中30歲以下青年博士無業率高達51.1%，首次超過半數。越來越多博士不僅找不到工作，甚至放棄求職。
即便在學術賽道最成熟的美國，博士就業歸宿也早已不侷限於大學。2024年美國研究生院理事會（CGS）發布的報告顯示，研究者對80位博士畢業生展開深入調研，大多數受訪者最終選擇進入產業界任職。
這些來自全球不同地區的現實，能否推出「中國博士過剩」的結論？若把總量、密度、結構三組數據放在一起，答案遠比想象中複雜。
如果只看絕對數量，中國已是世界上博士培養規模最大的國家之一；但按人口比重衡量，中國的博士仍然不夠多。聯合國教科文組織（UNESCO）數據顯示，2020年中國25歲及以上人口中，擁有博士或同等層次教育者約佔0.12%，美國2.09%，德國1.51%，英國為1.08%。
另據《文匯報》2025年11月報導，中國擁有博士學位者約120萬人，以14億多總人口計，比重不足0.1%，密度與發達國家相比仍有不小差距。
那麼，按結構衡量，中國處於什麼位置？總量之外，還有另一把尺子：博士生在整個高等教育體系中佔多大比重。
陳興德說，按OECD公布的2022年數據計算，博士及同等層次學生佔高等教育在校生的比例，美國約2.0%，法國約2.3%，英國約3.6%；按中國教育部同年數據測算，比例約1.2%。
陳興德提醒，由於中國「各種形式高等教育在學總規模」的統計口徑與OECD不完全一致，這組數字只能作為結構參考，不能當作嚴格同口徑排名——「英國高於美國，不能據此判斷美國培養不足；中國低於某些發達國家，也不能把差距直接換算成擴招名額。」
不過，拋開統計口徑的差異，一個現實感受是：學術賽道的「僧多粥少」確實加劇「過剩」觀感。將中國博士簡單冠以「過剩」之名顯然並不嚴謹，但為什麼這種觀感會如此強烈？
中國科學院院士韓啟德2024年在一個論壇上的比喻流傳甚廣：中國這麼大，各行各業長期需要人才，之所以顯得僧多粥少，一種可能是「我們給的『粥』種類太少」——不是博士太多，而是適合博士的舞台不夠大。
paras_en: In June 2026, at a graduation ceremony of a Chinese "211" university, drama and film studies PhD student Peng Jingping (pseudonym) learned from a counselor that among more than 20 classmates graduating in the same field this year, only two have actually secured jobs; even if those who have received admission offers but have not yet signed contracts are counted, the total barely reaches five.

The other classmates are in various situations: some have been sending resumes on job platforms for three months with no results, some have returned to their hometowns to wait for employment, and some, after several twists and turns, have ended up re‑signing with the institution where they worked before starting their PhD.

Behind these individuals is a continuously expanding cohort. Data show that in 2025 China enrolled 1.4385 million graduate students nationwide, including 201,600 PhDs and 1.2368 million master’s students; PhD enrollment rose 17.8% from 2024; master’s enrollment broke the 1.2 million mark for the first time, and the number of graduating master’s students also exceeded 1 million for the first time; the total number of graduate students in the country reached 4.2995 million, and the overall size of all forms of higher education reached 48.7257 million students, both historic highs.

Extending the timeline makes the expansion trajectory clearer. Ministry of Education statistical yearbooks show that PhD enrollment grew from 74,400 in 2015 to 201,600 in 2025, an increase of about 2.7‑fold over ten years; the number of PhDs in school rose from 342,000 in 2016 to 753,600, roughly a 1.2‑fold increase; the number of graduating PhDs rose from 55,000 in 2016 to 112,900, more than doubling.

Placed on a longer historical scale, today’s scale appears even more striking. On May 27 1983, the first 18 PhDs of the People’s Republic were awarded at the Great Hall of the People. In January 2008, data from the State Council’s Degree Committee showed that in the 29 years since reform and opening, a total of 240,000 PhDs had been awarded nationwide—today, annual PhD enrollment of 201,600 is close to 80% of that cumulative total.
Caixin magazine points out that the fact some PhDs have not yet found jobs does not mean the whole PhD cohort is oversupplied.

Professor Chen Xingde of Xiamen University’s Institute of Education Research emphasizes that the proportion of PhDs in the total population reflects long‑term accumulation, enrollment size reflects future supply, and employment reflects the match between talent and positions; the three cannot replace each other—"When discussing employment pressure, we should focus on the size and changes of the graduate cohort and not treat all 750,000 enrolled PhDs as if they entered the job market in the same year."

The most direct basis for the "PhD oversupply" argument comes from the academic track. Nature once published an article titled "How many PhDs does the world need? The number of PhD graduates far exceeds academic job openings," noting that over the past few decades the global number of PhD graduates has steadily expanded, but many face a shortage of academic positions, with research institutions unable to absorb them all, sparking concern in the scholarly community.
For a long time, under the academic prestige of a PhD, universities train students and students choose PhDs with the same goal—to become academic researchers.

Hugo Horta, a researcher on higher‑education policy at the University of Hong Kong, observes that "most students entering PhD programmes are still being trained with the aim of becoming scholars, so many graduates will face fierce competition for any academic position they pursue."

Horta’s observation reflects a global situation in PhD education, and the gap between expectation and reality also exists in China. Yan Guangcai, director of the Institute of Higher Education at East China Normal University, cited a 2022 survey of 2,300 enrolled PhD students, reporting that about 60% of them aspire to university jobs, with 75%‑80% of those in the humanities and social sciences.
Data released by the Ministry of Education in December 2023 show that among that year’s fresh PhD graduates, only about 40% actually entered universities or research institutions.

The crowding on the academic track is not unique to China. The Korean Statistical Information Service (KOSIS) released a 2025 survey of newly awarded domestic PhDs showing that among 10,498 new PhDs, 33.3% were unemployed—the highest rate since the survey began in 2014; among PhDs under 30, the unemployment rate reached 51.1%, exceeding half for the first time. More and more PhDs are not only unable to find jobs but are even giving up job hunting.

Even in the United States, where the academic track is most mature, PhD employment is no longer confined to universities. A 2024 report by the Council of Graduate Schools (CGS) that surveyed 80 PhD graduates found that most respondents ultimately chose positions in industry.

Do these realities from different regions of the world support the conclusion that "China has an oversupply of PhDs"? When total volume, density, and structure are considered together, the answer is far more complex than it appears.

If we look only at absolute numbers, China is already one of the world’s largest producers of PhDs; but measured by population share, China still has relatively few PhDs. UNESCO data show that in 2020, among Chinese people aged 25 and over, about 0.12% held a doctorate or equivalent, compared with 2.09% in the United States, 1.51% in Germany, and 1.08% in the United Kingdom.

According to a November 2025 report by Wen Wei Po, China has roughly 1.2 million doctorate holders; with a total population of over 1.4 billion, that accounts for less than 0.1%, a density still far behind that of developed countries.
So how does China rank when we consider structure? Beyond total numbers, another metric matters: the share of PhDs within the entire higher‑education system.

Chen Xingde notes that, based on OECD data for 2022, PhD‑level students account for about 2.0% of higher‑education enrolments in the United States, 2.3% in France, and 3.6% in the United Kingdom; using Chinese Ministry of Education data from the same year, the proportion is roughly 1.2%.

Chen cautions that because China’s definition of "total enrolment in all forms of higher education" does not align perfectly with OECD definitions, these figures should only serve as a structural reference and not be treated as strictly comparable rankings—"The United Kingdom’s higher share does not mean the U.S. trains too few; China’s lower share relative to some developed nations does not directly translate into larger admission quotas."

Nevertheless, setting aside definitional differences, a tangible perception is that the "too many mouths, too little porridge" situation on the academic track does intensify the sense of oversupply. Labeling Chinese PhDs as simply "oversupplied" is not rigorous, but why is this perception so strong?

Academician Han Qide of the Chinese Academy of Sciences famously analogized in a 2024 forum: China is vast and every sector needs talent long‑term; the apparent shortage of positions is perhaps because "the variety of 'porridge' we offer is too limited"—the issue is not too many PhDs, but an insufficiently large stage for them.

items.title: 〈台股風向球〉升息利空出盡站回4萬7 惟提防中秋連假前賣壓
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Outlook: Rate Hike Negatives Exhausted, Index Returns to 47,000; Watch for Pre‑Mid‑Autumn Holiday Selling Pressure
paras: 台股上周呈現聯準會升息後「利空出盡」態勢，加權指數反彈995.9點，站上47000點關卡，法人認為，有鑑於美國期中選舉壓力逐漸消化，本周可望持續看多，尤其美股記憶體指標Sandisk走強，有利推動台股記憶體股表現進而強化櫃買市場的短線交投信心，不過，隨著中秋連假到來、油價不確定因素仍高，仍須留意短彈的了結壓力來回拉鋸，使震盪加劇。
上周台股反彈近千點，投信呈現連4周買超，外資卻是連3周賣超，內外資對作反映國際資金的避險情緒升溫，但台股的強勁獲利展望穩住內資信心。
外資上周合計賣超185億元，主要賣超元大台灣50(0050-TW)達11.1萬張、凱基台灣TOP50(009816-TW)近8.2萬張、友達(2409-TW)7.2萬張、主動統一台股增長(00981A-TW)6萬張、中鋼(2002-TW)5.4萬張、彰銀(2801-TW)和群益台灣精選高息(00919-TW)均超過4.4萬張，南亞(1303-TW)4.3萬張。
台股交易員提到，瑞銀(UBS)最新報告大幅上修全球AI資本支出預測，其中約90%主要因記憶體成本攀升，推升記憶體股走勢，而記憶體股一般是中小股的信心來源，一旦被點火，連假前若無太大意外令櫃買指數的表現可期。
永豐投顧分析，FOMC如預期升息1碼，公債殖利率逐漸抬高，以適應通膨環境與高漲的油價，所幸目前市場普遍認為最快12月才可能再次升息，並非急遽收縮的環境，令短線變數消除，下次FOMC在10月28月召開，至少在10月下旬前市場可暫時擺脫利率政策不確定性干擾。
另一方面，美國期中選舉接近，根據經驗，選前壓縮過程會提前一個月，也就是對選舉結果沒信心的持股會在一個月前拋售，隨著台股震盪站上47000點，有擺脫盤局之勢。
paras_en: The Taiwan stock market showed a "negative news exhausted" pattern after the Fed’s rate hike last week, with the weighted index rebounding 995.9 points to break the 47,000‑point barrier. Institutional investors believe that, as the pressure from the U.S. mid‑term elections eases, the market can remain bullish this week, especially with the strong performance of the U.S. memory‑chip index Sandisk, which should boost Taiwan memory‑chip stocks and reinforce short‑term trading confidence in the over‑the‑counter market. However, with the Mid‑Autumn holiday approaching and oil‑price uncertainty still high, attention is needed on the pressure from short‑term profit‑taking that could intensify volatility.

Last week’s near‑1,000‑point rally saw mutual funds post a fourth consecutive week of net buying, while foreign investors recorded a third week of net selling. The contrasting flows reflect heightened hedging sentiment among international capital, yet the strong earnings outlook for Taiwan stocks keeps domestic confidence intact.

Foreign investors sold a total of NT$18.5 billion last week, led by net sales of 111,000 lots of Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW), about 82,000 lots of KGI Taiwan TOP50 (009816‑TW), 72,000 lots of AU Optronics (2409‑TW), 60,000 lots of Uni-President Taiwan Growth (00981A‑TW), 54,000 lots of China Steel (2002‑TW), and over 44,000 lots each of Chang Hwa Bank (2801‑TW) and Qunyi Taiwan High‑Yield Select (00919‑TW), with Nanya (1303‑TW) at 43,000 lots.

A Taiwan market trader noted that UBS’s latest report sharply raised its forecast for global AI capital spending, about 90% of which is driven by rising memory‑chip costs, lifting memory‑chip stocks. Since memory stocks are a key confidence driver for small‑cap equities, a spark in that sector could keep the over‑the‑counter index performing well before the holiday, barring any major surprises.

According to Yongfeng Investment Advisory, the FOMC’s expected one‑point rate hike is pushing government‑bond yields higher to accommodate inflation and soaring oil prices. Fortunately, the market broadly expects the next possible hike not until December, avoiding a rapid tightening environment and removing short‑term uncertainty. The next FOMC meeting is set for October 28, so at least until late October the market can temporarily escape rate‑policy volatility.

On the other hand, with the U.S. mid‑term elections looming, history shows that the pre‑election compression of positions tends to start a month early, meaning investors lacking confidence in the outcome begin selling about a month ahead. As the Taiwan market steadies above 47,000 points, there is a chance to break out of the current trading range.

items.title: 集團作帳行情助攻 南亞、台塑化季底有望進行補漲
items.title_en: Group Accounting Moves Boost South Asia and Formosa Plastics' Q3 Gains
paras: 據統計，台股今(2026)年度已大漲約62.9％，隨著接近本(9)月底，集團作帳行情也備受關注，包括聯電(2303-TW)、鴻海(2317-TW)及台塑(1301-TW)集團，投信拚季底績效的最後衝刺期，可望提前於本周發酵。觀察台塑集團中的南亞，投信上周周成交量來到32.8萬張、連7周買超，台塑化則是周成交12.5萬張，投信連3周買超。
法人指出，集團作帳行以年度觀察，通常在6月底、12月底較明顯，不過在9月底包括自營商及外資也有機會介入季底作帳加碼，有望獲得補漲行情。
另隨著布蘭特原油期貨近期飆破每桶100美元，台塑四寶近來也成為盤面焦點，在油價持續波動加劇，除了塑化本業「金九銀十」旺季可期，也兼有產品持續轉型的相關優勢。
包括南亞近年因轉型有成，8月電子材料占比已達6成，加上受惠AI浪潮驅動下，上(8)單月營收更創近50個月以來新高。據外資最新發布的研究報告中，形容南亞轉型已成功「華麗轉身」，除了傳統業務逐步復甦外，高毛利的電子材料事業更迎接爆發性成長，給予的目標價持續提升。
台塑化(6505-TW)則因美伊停火衝突持續升溫，年增5成為四寶中年增率表現最佳，隨著內銷油品吸收金額上(8)月比7月增加，致全產品平均售價僅比上月增加9.3美元/桶，台塑化持續調整產品組合，增加差異化產品比例，提升平均售價。
法人表示，受惠季底集團作帳行情，加上投信拚季底績效的最後衝刺期限，可望在本周持續發酵，包括傳產類股，因為今(2026)年股價基期較低，多具備股價跌深或或落後題材，隨著作帳行情啟動，一旦外資買盤持續進駐下，股價有望呈現一波補漲機會。
paras_en: According to statistics, the Taiwan stock market has surged about 62.9% so far this year (2026). As the end of September approaches, group accounting activity is drawing attention, especially for the United Microelectronics (2303‑TW), Hon Hai (2317‑TW) and Formosa Plastics (1301‑TW) groups. Mutual funds, racing to improve their quarter‑end performance, may see the effect materialise early this week. Looking at Formosa’s South Asia unit, mutual‑fund trading volume last week reached 328,000 shares, marking seven consecutive weeks of net buying, while Formosa Plastics’ chemical arm saw 125,000 shares traded with three weeks of net buying.

Institutions note that group accounting trends are usually most evident at the end of June and December, but at the end of September proprietary traders and foreign investors also have opportunities to step in for quarter‑end accounting additions, potentially sparking a catch‑up rally.

With Brent crude futures recently breaking the US$100 per barrel barrier, Formosa’s four core businesses have become market focal points. As oil price volatility intensifies, the plastics and petrochemical segment looks set for a strong “golden September‑October” season, while the company also benefits from ongoing product transformation advantages.

South Asia has seen successful transformation in recent years, with electronic materials accounting for 60% of its business in August. Driven by the AI wave, its August revenue hit a 50‑month high. A latest foreign‑institution research report praised South Asia’s “spectacular turnaround,” noting that beyond a gradual recovery of traditional lines, its high‑margin electronic materials business is poised for explosive growth, prompting upward revisions of its target price.

Formosa Plastics Chemical (6505‑TW) posted the best year‑over‑year growth among the four core units, up 50% amid the heated US‑Iran cease‑fire conflict. Domestic fuel sales rose in August versus July, lifting the average product price by only US$9.3 per barrel from the previous month. The company continues to adjust its product mix, increasing the share of differentiated products to raise average selling prices.

Institutions say that the quarter‑end group accounting activity, combined with mutual funds’ final push for quarter‑end performance, could keep fermenting throughout the week. Traditional‑industry stocks, which started the year at relatively low levels and often suffer deep declines or lagging themes, may experience a catch‑up rally once foreign‑investor buying gains momentum as the accounting window opens.

items.title: 俄羅斯首都莫斯科 遭遇有史以來最大規模襲擊
items.title_en: Russia's capital Moscow suffers its largest-ever attack
paras: 俄羅斯首都莫斯科市市長索比亞寧20日（周日）表示，莫斯科市當天遭遇史上最大規模襲擊，烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基在社交平台X發帖，就襲擊行動表態。
澤倫斯基20日在帖文中表示，烏克蘭昨晚對莫斯科地區的遠程打擊產生非常重大的影響，俄羅斯一個重要石油工業設施和後勤設施被擊中。
烏克蘭武裝部隊總參謀部通報，20日凌晨烏軍攻擊莫斯科煉油廠，煉油廠區域發生大規模火災，AVT-6初級煉油裝置、綜合原油加工裝置等遭到打擊。
烏軍稱，莫斯科煉油廠是俄羅斯最大煉油企業之一，年原油加工能力約1,200萬噸，生產車用汽油、柴油、航空燃料、重油等石油產品。烏方說，該煉油廠參與確保俄羅斯武裝力量需求。
據俄羅斯官員20日消息，莫斯科市和莫斯科州當天遭無人機襲擊。索比亞寧在社交媒體上說，19日以來共擊落1,600多架無人機，其中450架是在逼近莫斯科時被擊落。
據《美聯社》報導，索比亞寧將這波無人機襲擊描述為首都遭遇的有史以來最大規模襲擊，並表示莫斯科一家煉油廠和一棟居民樓遭到破壞。
paras_en: Moscow mayor Sobyanin said on Sunday the 20th that Moscow experienced the largest-scale attack in history, and Ukrainian President Zelensky posted on X about the attack.

In his post on the 20th, Zelensky said Ukraine's remote strike on the Moscow region last night had a very significant impact, hitting an important Russian oil industrial facility and a logistics facility.

The Ukrainian Armed Forces General Staff reported that in the early hours of the 20th Ukrainian forces attacked a Moscow refinery, causing a large fire in the refinery area, damaging the AVT-6 primary refining unit and integrated crude oil processing unit, among others.

Ukrainian forces said the Moscow refinery is one of Russia's largest refining companies, with an annual crude processing capacity of about 12 million tonnes, producing motor gasoline, diesel, aviation fuel, heavy oil and other petroleum products. The Ukrainian side said the refinery helps meet the needs of the Russian armed forces.

According to Russian officials on the 20th, Moscow city and Moscow region were attacked by drones that day. Sobyanin said on social media that since the 19th more than 1,600 drones have been shot down, including 450 that were downed as they approached Moscow.

The Associated Press reported that Sobyanin described this wave of drone attacks as the largest-scale attack ever suffered by the capital, and said a Moscow refinery and a residential building were damaged.

items.title: 長鑫科技第五代記憶體平台進入量產！製程縮至11.95奈米、推兩款LPDDR5X晶片
items.title_en: ChangXin Technology's Fifth-Generation Memory Platform Enters Mass Production, Process Shrinks to 11.95 nm, Launches Two LPDDR5X Chips
paras: 中國主要動態隨機存取記憶體（DRAM）製造商長鑫科技(688825-CN) 週日（20日）宣布，其第五代技術平台已進入量產階段。該公司宣稱，這項突破有望協助中國在全球記憶體晶片市場，與三星電子(005930KS) 、SK海力士(000660KS) 及美光科技(MU-US) 競爭。
根據《路透》報導，長鑫科技表示，新技術平台旨在以更低成本及更低功耗，生產效能更強大的記憶體晶片。DRAM是智慧型手機、電腦及其他裝置執行應用程式與軟體時所使用的短期工作記憶體。
長鑫今年已在上海證券交易所科創板掛牌上市，並指出新平台將為電子產品製造商提供更多智慧型手機及其他裝置所需晶片的供應來源。
長鑫表示，新平台能讓負責儲存資料的微小結構排列得更加緊密，使每顆晶片容納更多記憶體，並提高每片矽晶圓可生產的獨立晶片數量。
這家總部位於合肥的記憶體晶片製造商指出，已將晶片資料儲存區的關鍵結構間距縮小至11.95奈米，約為120億分之1公尺。
長鑫透過「四重圖案化」（quadruple patterning）技術達成這項成果。該製程會重複執行多個製造步驟，以形成更精細的電路圖案。
長鑫副總裁兼行銷中心負責人羅曉東在合肥舉行的2026年世界製造業大會上表示：「我們目前的製程能力，已與業界最先進的量產製程節點相當。」

長鑫科技推出兩款新型LPDDR5X晶片

長鑫同時發布兩款採用新平台製造的24Gb LPDDR5X產品。LPDDR5X屬於低功耗DRAM，主要應用於智慧型手機及其他可攜式電子裝置。
長鑫表示，這兩款產品的單顆容量較前一代同類產品增加50%，目前已進入量產，並提供兩種封裝形式，以因應不同智慧型手機及可攜式裝置的設計需求。
在晶圓生產效率方面，長鑫指出，以8Gb晶片作為基準，新平台每片晶圓可產出的晶粒總數，至少較第四代平台增加50%。
不過，公司強調，這項數據反映的是晶圓在扣除瑕疵品前的潛在晶粒產出數量，並不代表最終通過測試的晶片比例。
長鑫表示，新平台的開發結合電腦模擬技術，以及與中國晶片設備製造商在關鍵製程上的合作。
此次技術進展正值中國政府尋求降低對外國半導體技術依賴之際。自2022年起，美國出口管制已限制中國取得部分先進晶片製造設備及相關軟體。
paras_en: China's leading DRAM manufacturer ChangXin Technology (688825-CN) announced on Sunday (the 20th) that its fifth‑generation technology platform has entered mass production. The company says the breakthrough could help China compete in the global memory‑chip market against Samsung Electronics (005930KS), SK Hynix (000660KS) and Micron Technology (MU-US).

According to Reuters, ChangXin said the new platform is designed to produce higher‑performance memory chips at lower cost and lower power consumption. DRAM is the short‑term working memory used by smartphones, computers and other devices when running applications and software.

ChangXin, which listed on the Science and Technology Innovation Board of the Shanghai Stock Exchange this year, noted that the new platform will give electronics manufacturers an additional source of chips for smartphones and other devices.

The company said the new platform allows the tiny data‑storage structures to be packed more tightly, enabling each chip to hold more memory and increasing the number of individual chips that can be produced from each silicon wafer.
The Hefei‑based memory‑chip maker said it has reduced the critical spacing of the chip’s data‑storage structures to 11.95 nm, roughly 1.2 × 10⁻⁹ m.
ChangXin achieved this using a quadruple‑patterning technique, which repeats multiple manufacturing steps to create finer circuit patterns.

Vice‑President and head of the marketing center Luo Xiaodong told the 2026 World Manufacturing Conference in Hefei, "Our current process capability is comparable to the most advanced mass‑production nodes in the industry."
ChangXin Technology also launched two new 24‑Gb LPDDR5X chips.

The company said the two products each have 50% more capacity per die than the previous generation, are already in mass production, and are offered in two package types to meet different smartphone and portable‑device design needs.
Regarding wafer‑production efficiency, ChangXin noted that using an 8‑Gb chip as a benchmark, the new platform can produce at least 50% more dies per wafer than the fourth‑generation platform.
However, the company stressed that this figure reflects the potential die count before accounting for defective chips and does not represent the final pass‑rate after testing.
ChangXin said the platform’s development combined computer simulation with collaboration with Chinese chip‑equipment makers on key processes.

The advancement comes as the Chinese government seeks to reduce reliance on foreign semiconductor technology; since 2022, U.S. export controls have limited China’s access to certain advanced chip‑manufacturing equipment and related software.

items.title: 本週操盤筆記：全球PMI、歐亞非多國央行利率決議、川習二會登場
items.title_en: Trading Notes This Week: Global PMI, Multiple Central Bank Rate Decisions Across Europe, Asia and Africa, and the Trump‑Xi Summit
paras: 未來一周，市場將聚焦於標普全球9月採購經理人指數(PMI)初值，以及全球多國央行利率決議。美國9月PMI初值將在周三(23日)出爐，將提供有關當前經濟活動的最新情況，歐元區和英國也將公佈PMI數據，瑞士、瑞典、挪威、墨西哥和南非則將公佈最新利率決議。與此同時，市場正消化聯準會(Fed)上周升息決定，並評估未來進一步升息的前景。
在亞洲，中國將公佈基準貸款利率，印尼央行也將召開利率制定會議。此外，市場也將密切關注美國總統川普與中國大陸國家主席習近平之間的峰會。在美中之間諸多議題中，AI領域競爭以及涉及半導體管制的限制措施恐將影響市場。
1. 全球PMI
美國周三公布的9月製造業和服務業PMI初值料將反映近期油價飆升之下的企業表現，數據中顯現的任何強勁跡象，都可能進一步強化市場對Fed將進一步升息的預期。
ING經濟學家James Knightley在一份報告中寫道：「目前聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)中僅兩位成員認為今年不會再升息，這顯示委員會內部已出現廣泛的鷹派立場調整。」
同日，英國、法國、德國及歐元區9月PMI初值也將出爐，日本PMI初值則預計在周四(24日)發布，而歐元區與法國的9月消費者信心指數初值也將在周二(22日)及周四出爐，尤其值得注意的是周四登場的德國9月Ifo商業景氣指數，以及隔天公佈的德國GfK 10月消費者信心指數。
2. 歐亞非多國利率決議
瑞士央行將於周四宣布最新利率決議，市場普遍預期維持利率在0%不變，因瑞士通膨率仍低。市場將密切關注瑞士央行針對近期能源飆漲的影響、強勢瑞郎以及可能採取的外匯干預措施的任何發言。
同日，北歐國家瑞典與挪威也將公佈利率決議，市場預估將分別維持在1.75%與4.25%不變。野村證券表示，瑞典央行正逐步接近升息，但即使考量近期財政政策變化，通膨率仍低，且經濟展現出越來越強的韌性，第二季GDP成長強勁。

在亞洲，中國人民銀行(央行)周一(21日)將公布貸款一年期與五年期市場報價利率(LPR)，市場將從中尋求進一步貨幣政策支持經濟的跡象。星展銀行經濟學家預估，一年期LPR將維持在3%不變，維持溫和寬鬆的政策立場，因中國強勁出口表現和工業活動將繼續支撐經濟成長。「在此背景下，決策者可能會維持溫和的政策立場，依靠有針對性的財政支持來維持經濟成長，而不是進一步降息。」一年期LPR影響大多數企業和家庭貸款，而五年期LPR則是抵押貸款的基準利率。
法國興業銀行策略師則認為，近期經濟數據強化市場對進一步貨幣政策支持的預期。中國8月零售銷售僅年增0.4%，且今年以來固定資產投資成長放緩至7.2%，工業生產則仍表現亮眼。
周三，印尼央行也將做出最新利率決議，市場預估將維持於5.75%不變。星展銀行經濟學家表示，新上任的印尼央行總裁Destry Damayanti可能會強調全球金融環境緊縮和地緣政治緊張局勢是當前面臨的主要風險，同時指出印尼經濟仍保持相對韌性。
ING經濟學家Deepali Bhargava和Lynn Song則指出，繼8月採取「鴿派」暫停升息舉措，加上在外資資金流入支撐印尼盾近期升值後，印尼央行將按兵不動，但第四季有升息1碼的機率。
同一天，南非央行也可能宣布升息1碼至7.25%，主要因為擔心近期油價飆升恐推高通膨。滙豐銀行經濟學家出具研報指出，油價上漲引發的短期通膨上升、通膨預期不一及發達國家同步升息的趨勢，都為南非央行緊縮貨幣政策提供充分理由。
3. 川習二會
繼今年5月北京峰會後，中國大陸國家主席習近平將於周四(24日)抵達華府，進行十年來首次白宮之行，並會晤美國總統川普。除圍繞台灣和伊朗問題外，此次會晤背景也相當微妙，今年中國貿易順差數字有望創下連兩年超過1兆美元的紀錄，川普則正忙於應對與伊朗的戰爭，以及即將來臨的期中選舉。
paras_en: In the coming week, markets will focus on the S&P Global September Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) flash estimate and rate decisions by several central banks worldwide. The U.S. September PMI flash will be released on Wednesday (the 23rd), providing the latest snapshot of economic activity, while the euro‑area and the United Kingdom will also publish PMI data. Switzerland, Sweden, Norway, Mexico and South Africa are set to announce their latest rate decisions. At the same time, the market is digesting the Fed’s rate‑hike decision from last week and assessing the outlook for further tightening.

In Asia, China will release its benchmark loan rates and Indonesia’s central bank will hold a rate‑setting meeting. Markets will also be closely watching the summit between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping. Among the many U.S.–China issues, competition in AI and semiconductor‑related export controls are likely to affect markets.
This week’s trading notes (09/21‑09/25).
1. Global PMI

The September manufacturing and services PMI flash numbers to be released by the United States on Wednesday are expected to reflect corporate performance amid recent oil‑price spikes. Any signs of strength in the data could further reinforce market expectations that the Fed will continue to raise rates.

ING economist James Knightley wrote in a note: “Only two members of the Federal Open Market Committee currently think there will be no more hikes this year, indicating a broad shift toward a more hawkish stance within the committee.”

On the same day, the United Kingdom, France, Germany and the euro‑area will also release their September PMI flash numbers. Japan’s PMI flash is slated for Thursday (the 24th). The euro‑area and France will publish their September consumer‑confidence flash readings on Tuesday (the 22nd) and Thursday, respectively. Of particular note are Germany’s September Ifo business‑climate index on Thursday and the German GfK October consumer‑confidence index released the following day.
2. Rate decisions across Europe, Asia and Africa

The Swiss National Bank is expected to announce its latest rate decision on Thursday, with markets broadly anticipating that the policy rate will stay at 0% as inflation remains low. Attention will be on any comments regarding the impact of recent energy price surges, the strong franc and possible foreign‑exchange intervention measures.

On the same day, the Nordic countries Sweden and Norway will also publish their rate decisions, with markets forecasting rates to remain unchanged at 1.75% and 4.25% respectively. Nomura says the Swedish central bank is edging closer to a hike, but despite recent fiscal‑policy shifts inflation is still low and the economy is showing increasing resilience, with strong Q2 GDP growth.

In Asia, the People’s Bank of China will publish the one‑year and five‑year Loan Prime Rates (LPR) on Monday (the 21st). Analysts at DBS expect the one‑year LPR to stay at 3%, maintaining a moderately accommodative stance as robust export performance and industrial activity continue to support growth. They note that policymakers are likely to keep a gentle policy stance and rely on targeted fiscal support rather than further cuts. The one‑year LPR affects most corporate and household loans, while the five‑year LPR serves as the benchmark for mortgages.

Société Générale strategists say recent Chinese data reinforce expectations for further monetary support. China’s August retail sales rose only 0.4% year‑on‑year, fixed‑asset investment growth slowed to 7.2% this year, and industrial production remains strong.

On Wednesday, Indonesia’s central bank will announce its latest rate decision, with markets expecting the policy rate to stay unchanged at 5.75%. DBS economists note that the newly appointed governor Destry Damayanti may stress that a tightening global financial environment and geopolitical tensions are the main risks, while also pointing out that Indonesia’s economy remains relatively resilient.

ING economists Deepali Bhargava and Lynn Song say that after the dovish pause in August and recent foreign‑capital inflows that have helped the rupiah appreciate, the central bank is likely to hold steady, though there is a chance of a 0.25‑percentage‑point hike in Q4.

On the same day, the South African Reserve Bank may raise its rate by one basis point to 7.25% due to concerns that recent oil‑price spikes could push inflation higher. HSBC economists argue that the short‑term inflation lift from higher oil, divergent inflation expectations and synchronized rate hikes in advanced economies all give the SARB ample reason to tighten monetary policy.
3. Trump‑Xi summit

Following the May summit in Beijing, Chinese President Xi Jinping will travel to Washington on Thursday (the 24th) for his first White House visit in a decade, meeting U.S. President Donald Trump. In addition to discussions on Taiwan and Iran, the backdrop is delicate: China’s trade surplus is set to exceed $1 trillion for a second consecutive year, while Trump is busy dealing with the war in Iran and the upcoming mid‑term elections.

paras:
台股盤前要聞 

1.經濟部18日召開2026年第2次電價費率審議會，會後記者會由次長賴建信主持。審議委員會指出，影響本期電價的主因為中東戰事，國際燃料價格大漲導致發購電成本大幅攀升，為避免引發國內物價波動，會議決議支持優先爭取政府撥補預算711億元，因此本次電價調整暫不決定，留待今年12月併入第3次電價審議會審議輸配電費率時再行討論，意味著最快調漲電價的時間點將落在明年1月。
2.台北股市18日在各不確定性消除之後，大盤終場以上漲892.75點收盤，報47180.75點，成交值逾1.07兆元，龐大量能潮補足昨日未能站穩4700點遺憾。外資在期貨、現貨同步做多，買超869.94億元創台股中第5大買超，加碼個股以記憶體族群為主。儘管外資連續2日買超共991.79億元，全周仍賣超184.64億元。
3. 上海航運交易所18日公布最新上海出口集裝箱運價指數，綜合指數較前一期上漲25.65點至3687.83點，漲幅約0.7%，已連續第八周上漲；其中美東、美西線也持續走強。
4. LED大廠富采(3714-TW)18日代子公司富采光電公告自3/9-3/18期間，依市場價格取得關係人友達(2409-TW)普通股股票共計73128張，每股平均價格為20.48元，交易總金額約達14.98億元。本次交易完成後，富采累計持有友達持股比例達0.97%，主要目的在於增進集團策略協同效益，發揮永動機策略結盟綜效，並持續擴大集團在高附加價值應用的市場版圖。
5. 仁寶(2324-TW)18日與鋐寶分別召開董事會，並於晚間召開重訊記者會，通過以現金為對價的股份轉換案，此次股份轉換對價為每股18.5元，股份轉換完成後，鋐寶將成為仁寶100%持股子公司。

paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs held the second 2026 electricity tariff review meeting on the 18th, with Deputy Minister Lai Chien‑hsin chairing the post‑meeting press conference. The review committee said the main factor affecting the current electricity price is the Middle‑East conflict, which has driven international fuel prices sharply higher and pushed power‑generation costs up dramatically. To avoid domestic price volatility, the meeting resolved to prioritize securing a government subsidy of NT$71.1 billion, so the tariff adjustment will not be decided now and will be deferred to the third tariff review in December when transmission and distribution rates are examined. This means the earliest possible price hike would be in January 2027.

On the 18th, after various uncertainties cleared, the Taipei stock market closed up 892.75 points at 47,180.75, with a turnover exceeding NT$1.07 trillion, recouping the missed 4,700‑point level from the previous day. Foreign investors bought net NT$86.994 billion in both futures and spot markets, ranking as the fifth‑largest net purchase in Taiwan equities, focusing mainly on memory‑chip stocks. Although foreign investors posted net purchases for two consecutive days totaling NT$99.179 billion, they still recorded a net sell of NT$18.464 billion for the week.

The Shanghai Shipping Exchange released its latest Shanghai Export Container Freight Index on the 18th. The composite index rose 25.65 points to 3,687.83, an increase of about 0.7%, marking the eighth consecutive week of gains. The East‑Coast US and West‑Coast US routes also continued to strengthen.

LED giant Foxconn (3714‑TW) announced on the 18th, via its subsidiary Foxconn Optoelectronics, that it purchased 73,128 shares of related party AU Optronics (2409‑TW) at an average price of NT$20.48 per share between March 9 and March 18, for a total transaction value of approximately NT$1.498 billion. After the deal, Foxconn’s cumulative stake in AU Optronics reaches 0.97%. The acquisition aims to enhance group strategic synergies, leverage the “perpetual motion” alliance effect, and further expand the group’s footprint in high‑value‑added applications.

Wistron (2324‑TW) held board meetings with Honbo on the 18th and later held a press conference, approving a cash‑for‑stock swap at NT$18.5 per share. Upon completion, Honbo will become a wholly‑owned subsidiary of Wistron, deepening its Edge‑AI strategy.
Electricity prices remain frozen as the review panel voted to prioritize securing a NT$71.1 billion government subsidy, with tariff rates postponed for combined review in December.
Foreign investors aggressively bought futures and spot stocks, netting NT$86.9 billion—the fifth‑largest net purchase on record—while still posting a net sell of NT$18.4 billion for the week.
<Shipping Index> A surge of shipments ahead of the ten‑day holiday lifted the SCFI for the eighth straight week, with both the US West Coast and East Coast lanes rallying.
Foxconn’s acquisition of 73,128 AU Optronics shares deepens the group’s “3+1” strategic alliance synergy.
Wistron’s cash payment of NT$18.5 per share to acquire Honbo’s entire equity strengthens its Edge‑AI positioning.
<Apple New Release> The iPhone 18 Pro series hits the market, with the three major telecom carriers deploying different pricing strategies to attract customers.
The three AI giants call for a slowdown, yet Wistron’s Lin Hsien‑ming and Pegatron’s Tong Tzu‑hsien remain optimistic about the AI industry.
Shengda Technology’s August revenue reached NT$321 million, a new high for the period, with analysts forecasting strong earnings growth before year‑end.
200 GB PD mass production eases material shortages, and Uni‑World KY’s Q3 results are expected to warm up quarter by quarter.
Wah Hsing Light’s new product line is projected to scale up in the second half of 2027, with institutional investors estimating that capacity expansion could trigger rapid growth.
Biomedical and drone sectors see major upgrades: Taiwan‑Kang Sheng, Ju‑Yang, Cai‑Yu, and Patriot Green Energy have all been approved for the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ A+ program.

items.title: 〈台股風向球〉升息利空出盡站回4萬7 惟提防中秋連假前賣壓
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Outlook: Rate Hike Negatives Exhausted, Index Returns to 47,000; Watch for Pre‑Mid‑Autumn Holiday Selling Pressure
paras: 台股上周呈現聯準會升息後「利空出盡」態勢，加權指數反彈995.9點，站上47000點關卡，法人認為，有鑑於美國期中選舉壓力逐漸消化，本周可望持續看多，尤其美股記憶體指標Sandisk走強，有利推動台股記憶體股表現進而強化櫃買市場的短線交投信心，不過，隨著中秋連假到來、油價不確定因素仍高，仍須留意短彈的了結壓力來回拉鋸，使震盪加劇。
上周台股反彈近千點，投信呈現連4周買超，外資卻是連3周賣超，內外資對作反映國際資金的避險情緒升溫，但台股的強勁獲利展望穩住內資信心。
外資上周合計賣超185億元，主要賣超元大台灣50(0050-TW)達11.1萬張、凱基台灣TOP50(009816-TW)近8.2萬張、友達(2409-TW)7.2萬張、主動統一台股增長(00981A-TW)6萬張、中鋼(2002-TW)5.4萬張、彰銀(2801-TW)和群益台灣精選高息(00919-TW)均超過4.4萬張，南亞(1303-TW)4.3萬張。
台股交易員提到，瑞銀(UBS)最新報告大幅上修全球AI資本支出預測，其中約90%主要因記憶體成本攀升，推升記憶體股走勢，而記憶體股一般是中小股的信心來源，一旦被點火，連假前若無太大意外令櫃買指數的表現可期。
永豐投顧分析，FOMC如預期升息1碼，公債殖利率逐漸抬高，以適應通膨環境與高漲的油價，所幸目前市場普遍認為最快12月才可能再次升息，並非急遽收縮的環境，令短線變數消除，下次FOMC在10月28月召開，至少在10月下旬前市場可暫時擺脫利率政策不確定性干擾。
另一方面，美國期中選舉接近，根據經驗，選前壓縮過程會提前一個月，也就是對選舉結果沒信心的持股會在一個月前拋售，隨著台股震盪站上47000點，有擺脫盤局之勢。
paras_en: The Taiwan stock market showed a "negative news exhausted" pattern after the Fed’s rate hike last week, with the weighted index rebounding 995.9 points to break the 47,000‑point barrier. Institutional investors believe that, as the pressure from the U.S. mid‑term elections eases, the market can remain bullish this week, especially with the strong performance of the U.S. memory‑chip index Sandisk, which should boost Taiwan memory‑chip stocks and reinforce short‑term trading confidence in the over‑the‑counter market. However, with the Mid‑Autumn holiday approaching and oil‑price uncertainty still high, attention is needed on the pressure from short‑term profit‑taking that could intensify volatility.

Last week’s near‑1,000‑point rally saw mutual funds post a fourth consecutive week of net buying, while foreign investors recorded a third week of net selling. The contrasting flows reflect heightened hedging sentiment among international capital, yet the strong earnings outlook for Taiwan stocks keeps domestic confidence intact.

Foreign investors sold a total of NT$18.5 billion last week, led by net sales of 111,000 lots of Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW), about 82,000 lots of KGI Taiwan TOP50 (009816‑TW), 72,000 lots of AU Optronics (2409‑TW), 60,000 lots of Uni-President Taiwan Growth (00981A‑TW), 54,000 lots of China Steel (2002‑TW), and over 44,000 lots each of Chang Hwa Bank (2801‑TW) and Qunyi Taiwan High‑Yield Select (00919‑TW), with Nanya (1303‑TW) at 43,000 lots.

A Taiwan market trader noted that UBS’s latest report sharply raised its forecast for global AI capital spending, about 90% of which is driven by rising memory‑chip costs, lifting memory‑chip stocks. Since memory stocks are a key confidence driver for small‑cap equities, a spark in that sector could keep the over‑the‑counter index performing well before the holiday, barring any major surprises.

According to Yongfeng Investment Advisory, the FOMC’s expected one‑point rate hike is pushing government‑bond yields higher to accommodate inflation and soaring oil prices. Fortunately, the market broadly expects the next possible hike not until December, avoiding a rapid tightening environment and removing short‑term uncertainty. The next FOMC meeting is set for October 28, so at least until late October the market can temporarily escape rate‑policy volatility.

On the other hand, with the U.S. mid‑term elections looming, history shows that the pre‑election compression of positions tends to start a month early, meaning investors lacking confidence in the outcome begin selling about a month ahead. As the Taiwan market steadies above 47,000 points, there is a chance to break out of the current trading range.

items.title: 集團作帳行情助攻 南亞、台塑化季底有望進行補漲
items.title_en: Group Accounting Moves Boost South Asia and Formosa Plastics' Q3 Gains
paras: 據統計，台股今(2026)年度已大漲約62.9％，隨著接近本(9)月底，集團作帳行情也備受關注，包括聯電(2303-TW)、鴻海(2317-TW)及台塑(1301-TW)集團，投信拚季底績效的最後衝刺期，可望提前於本周發酵。觀察台塑集團中的南亞，投信上周周成交量來到32.8萬張、連7周買超，台塑化則是周成交12.5萬張，投信連3周買超。
法人指出，集團作帳行以年度觀察，通常在6月底、12月底較明顯，不過在9月底包括自營商及外資也有機會介入季底作帳加碼，有望獲得補漲行情。
另隨著布蘭特原油期貨近期飆破每桶100美元，台塑四寶近來也成為盤面焦點，在油價持續波動加劇，除了塑化本業「金九銀十」旺季可期，也兼有產品持續轉型的相關優勢。
包括南亞近年因轉型有成，8月電子材料占比已達6成，加上受惠AI浪潮驅動下，上(8)單月營收更創近50個月以來新高。據外資最新發布的研究報告中，形容南亞轉型已成功「華麗轉身」，除了傳統業務逐步復甦外，高毛利的電子材料事業更迎接爆發性成長，給予的目標價持續提升。
台塑化(6505-TW)則因美伊停火衝突持續升溫，年增5成為四寶中年增率表現最佳，隨著內銷油品吸收金額上(8)月比7月增加，致全產品平均售價僅比上月增加9.3美元/桶，台塑化持續調整產品組合，增加差異化產品比例，提升平均售價。
法人表示，受惠季底集團作帳行情，加上投信拚季底績效的最後衝刺期限，可望在本周持續發酵，包括傳產類股，因為今(2026)年股價基期較低，多具備股價跌深或或落後題材，隨著作帳行情啟動，一旦外資買盤持續進駐下，股價有望呈現一波補漲機會。
paras_en: According to statistics, the Taiwan stock market has surged about 62.9% so far this year (2026). As the end of September approaches, group accounting activity is drawing attention, especially for the United Microelectronics (2303‑TW), Hon Hai (2317‑TW) and Formosa Plastics (1301‑TW) groups. Mutual funds, racing to improve their quarter‑end performance, may see the effect materialise early this week. Looking at Formosa’s South Asia unit, mutual‑fund trading volume last week reached 328,000 shares, marking seven consecutive weeks of net buying, while Formosa Plastics’ chemical arm saw 125,000 shares traded with three weeks of net buying.

Institutions note that group accounting trends are usually most evident at the end of June and December, but at the end of September proprietary traders and foreign investors also have opportunities to step in for quarter‑end accounting additions, potentially sparking a catch‑up rally.

With Brent crude futures recently breaking the US$100 per barrel barrier, Formosa’s four core businesses have become market focal points. As oil price volatility intensifies, the plastics and petrochemical segment looks set for a strong “golden September‑October” season, while the company also benefits from ongoing product transformation advantages.

South Asia has seen successful transformation in recent years, with electronic materials accounting for 60% of its business in August. Driven by the AI wave, its August revenue hit a 50‑month high. A latest foreign‑institution research report praised South Asia’s “spectacular turnaround,” noting that beyond a gradual recovery of traditional lines, its high‑margin electronic materials business is poised for explosive growth, prompting upward revisions of its target price.

Formosa Plastics Chemical (6505‑TW) posted the best year‑over‑year growth among the four core units, up 50% amid the heated US‑Iran cease‑fire conflict. Domestic fuel sales rose in August versus July, lifting the average product price by only US$9.3 per barrel from the previous month. The company continues to adjust its product mix, increasing the share of differentiated products to raise average selling prices.

Institutions say that the quarter‑end group accounting activity, combined with mutual funds’ final push for quarter‑end performance, could keep fermenting throughout the week. Traditional‑industry stocks, which started the year at relatively low levels and often suffer deep declines or lagging themes, may experience a catch‑up rally once foreign‑investor buying gains momentum as the accounting window opens.

items.title: 親子客首選 長榮航連11年獲評五星航空「家庭友善航空公司」拿世界第一
items.title_en: Parent‑Child Travelers' Top Choice: EVA Air Wins Five‑Star Rating for 11th Consecutive Year and Ranked World’s #1 Family‑Friendly Airline
paras: 擁有「航空界奧斯卡」美譽的知名航空業調查機構SKYTRAX公布第27屆全球航空公司大獎(World Airline Awards)，長榮航(2618-TW)不僅連續11年被評選為五星級航空公司，更勇奪2026年「全球最佳豪華經濟艙」、「最佳豪華經濟艙服務用品」和「全球最佳家庭友善航空公司」三項世界第一，此次共計囊括18個TOP 10獎項。
長榮航首席副總經理廖至維表示，今年除了連續11年獲SKYTRAX五星級航空的殊榮，也再次獲得多項全球航空大獎，成就得來不易，榮耀屬於全體長榮航空員工。
SKYTRAX Edward Plaisted執行長表示，長榮航空榮獲「全球最佳家庭友善航空公司」殊榮，這項成就充分肯定長榮航空致力於為攜帶孩童出行的旅客，打造更順暢、輕鬆且舒適旅程的努力。
此外，長榮航早在1992年領先全球率先推出豪華經濟艙，該艙等已成為成長最快速的客艙類別之一。
全球航空業權威調查機構SKYTRAX自1999年起舉辦全球航空公司大獎，針對航空公司的產品與服務進行全球旅客滿意度調查，並提供英語、法語、西班牙語、日語及中文等多國語言選項，是國際旅客選擇航空公司的重要參考指標。
paras_en: The renowned airline research firm SKYTRAX, often called the “Oscars of the aviation industry,” announced the 27th World Airline Awards. EVA Air (2618‑TW) not only retained its five‑star airline rating for the 11th straight year, but also captured three world‑first titles in 2026: Global Best Premium Economy Cabin, Best Premium Economy Cabin Service Products, and Global Best Family‑Friendly Airline, bringing its total to 18 Top‑10 awards.

EVA Air’s senior vice president Liao Chih‑Wei said that, in addition to the eleven‑year streak of SKYTRAX five‑star recognition, the airline has again earned multiple global aviation awards this year. He stressed that the achievement was hard‑won and that the honor belongs to all EVA Air employees.

SKYTRAX CEO Edward Plaisted said EVA Air’s award as Global Best Family‑Friendly Airline fully validates the carrier’s efforts to create smoother, more relaxed and comfortable journeys for passengers traveling with children.
Moreover, EVA Air pioneered the premium‑economy cabin worldwide back in 1992, a cabin class that has since become one of the fastest‑growing segments in the industry.

Since 1999, the authoritative global aviation research organization SKYTRAX has run the World Airline Awards, surveying worldwide passenger satisfaction with airline products and services. It offers surveys in English, French, Spanish, Japanese and Chinese, making it a key reference for international travelers when choosing airlines.

items.title: 台灣最大主動債ETF熱度不墜！00984D規模狂飆6.5倍 10/5第6次配息
items.title_en: Taiwan's Largest Active Bond ETF Keeps Hot Momentum! 00984D Surges 6.5‑Fold, Sixth Dividend on Oct 5
paras: 首檔突破百億大關的台灣最大主動式債券ETF迎來最新配息訊息！聯博投信主動式非投資等級債券ETF「聯博優選全球非投資等級債券主動式ETF」 (00984D-TW) 即將進行第六次配息，預計於10月5日除息，每受益權單位預估配息金額為0.085元，與前五次維持一致。想要參與本次配息的投資人，最晚需在10月2日買進。
00984D自今年1月成立以來，市場熱度持續高漲。截至9月11日，受益人數已大幅成長約528%；基金規模更自8月底率先成為台灣首檔突破百億元的主動式債券ETF後持續攀升，成長高達約651%，穩居台灣規模最大的主動式債券ETF寶座，顯見市場對收益型資產與主動式債券ETF的配置需求相當顯著。
聯博投信ETF發展部副總經理鍾郁婕分析，今年台股表現亮眼，但隨著股市集中度升高、波動加劇，投資組合分散配置的需求也隨之提升。相較股票，非投資等級債券波動度相對較低，且具備較高收益潛力，適度納入投資組合有助分散單一資產風險。同時，在美國通膨仍具黏著性、經濟展現韌性的背景下，非投資等級債的高債息可提供收益緩衝，較短的存續期間也有助降低利率波動對債券價格的影響。
此外，AI投資熱潮亦為非投資等級債市挹注新動能。全球超大型雲端服務商持續擴大AI資本支出，帶動參與資料中心建設與維護的「傳統經濟」非投資等級債發行企業受惠。另一方面，美國消費支出維持韌性，亦支撐博弈、休閒、住宿及零售等產業。
00984D透過主動選債與全球布局，以全球非投資等級企業債為核心，聚焦BB與B級券種，涵蓋能源、醫療、科技、媒體及基礎建設等產業。面對產業基本面分化，團隊動態調整配置，減碼基本面承壓的通訊與科技業，並靈活切入評價具吸引力的標的。
展望後市，鍾郁婕表示，00984D搭配約2.9年的短存續期間，能在控制信用與利率風險的同時掌握收益。在股市高檔震盪之際，將持續扮演投資人分散波動、增加收益來源的關鍵資產。

paras_en: The first Taiwanese active bond ETF to break the NT$100 billion mark is announcing its latest dividend. Lianbo Investment Trust’s active non‑investment‑grade bond ETF “Lianbo Preferred Global Non‑Investment‑Grade Bond Active ETF” (00984D‑TW) will make its sixth dividend distribution, with an ex‑dividend date of October 5. Each unit is expected to pay NT$0.085, the same as the previous five payouts. Investors who wish to receive this dividend must purchase the ETF no later than October 2.

Since its launch in January, 00984D has seen sustained market enthusiasm. As of September 11, the number of holders had grown about 528%, and the fund’s assets, after becoming Taiwan’s first active bond ETF to exceed NT$100 billion at the end of August, have risen roughly 651%, keeping it the largest active bond ETF in Taiwan and highlighting strong demand for yield‑oriented assets and active bond ETFs.

Zhong Yu‑jie, Deputy General Manager of the ETF Development Department at Lianbo Investment Trust, noted that this year’s Taiwan stock market performed well, but rising concentration and volatility have increased the need for diversified portfolios. Compared with equities, non‑investment‑grade bonds are less volatile and offer higher yield potential, making them a useful addition for risk diversification. Moreover, with persistent U.S. inflation and a resilient economy, the high coupons of high‑yield bonds provide a buffer, while their relatively short durations help mitigate price swings from interest‑rate changes.

The AI investment boom is also injecting new momentum into the high‑yield bond market. Global mega‑cloud service providers continue to expand AI‑related capital expenditures, benefiting “traditional‑economy” high‑yield issuers involved in data‑center construction and maintenance. At the same time, resilient U.S. consumer spending supports sectors such as gaming, leisure, hospitality, and retail.

00984D employs active bond selection and a global mandate, focusing on worldwide non‑investment‑grade corporate bonds, primarily BB and B‑rated issues across energy, healthcare, technology, media, and infrastructure. Facing sector‑specific fundamentals, the team dynamically adjusts allocations, trimming exposure to pressured communication and technology sectors while flexibly entering attractively‑valued opportunities.

Looking ahead, Zhong said that 00984D’s roughly 2.9‑year average duration allows it to manage credit and interest‑rate risk while capturing yield. Amid high‑level stock market turbulence, the fund will continue to serve as a key asset for investors seeking volatility diversification and additional income sources.

items.title: 成本推升及內需消費平淡 台系家電廠多軌迎戰下半年
items.title_en: Rising Costs and Tepid Domestic Demand: Taiwanese Home Appliance Makers Brace for the Second Half
paras: 受AI基礎建設需求與地緣政治推升原物料走勢影響，銅、鋁、鐵、塑膠粒及記憶體等製造成本居高不下，加上台灣內需市場消費不振，終端家電市場醞釀新一波漲價潮維持獲利，並適逢政府節能家電汰舊換新補助與貨物稅減免進入最後實施階段，聲寶(1604-TW)、三洋電(1614-TW)與禾聯碩(5283-TW)等本土家電品牌可望於下半年營運增添轉機。
面對源頭成本墊高，台灣家電業者普遍採取凍漲抗壓與新品調價雙軌戰略。市場普遍預期一般冰箱與洗衣機等品項漲幅落在3%至5%左右，其中液晶電視受到記憶體等關鍵零組件價格飆漲影響，成本反映幅度預料最為顯著。
業者多規劃在現階段夏季主力品項維持既有報價，待配合第四季新品發表、機型切換或新國家一級能效基準發布時，再逐波適度調漲售價以平攤製造成本壓力。
在個別台廠營運展望方面，聲寶前8月家電本業營收大致持平，其中冷凍櫃、洗衣機與液晶電視銷售相對突出，空調則透過聲寶與瑞智雙品牌維持成長。三洋電前5月合併營收為21.89億元，年減9.26%，公司看好下半年在夏季高溫及年底補助衝刺帶動下，表現將反轉優於去年並力拚將上半年跌幅全數補回。
禾聯碩今年營運預估與去年持平至維持成長，主力空調年銷量約20多萬台，並透過禾聯、夏普以及山田空調三品牌完整覆蓋高、中、低不同價位帶市場。
面對中國大陸品牌以低價策略跨海搶市，甚至將11公斤級洗衣機價格壓至萬元出頭，本土與外商家電業者紛紛將競爭主軸轉向全生命週期的後勤服務體系。
台灣業者積極擴充自有物流倉儲、配送安裝與全台直營維修據點，同時導入高階一級能效機種與醫療用特殊設備，外商如台灣LG亦鎖定30至49歲中高階客群，推動冷氣占比達6成的家電租賃與定期保養模式，藉此築起價格戰難以跨越的服務護城河。
為開創家電硬體銷售以外的長期收益，主要台廠亦加速跨足資產開發與高齡照護事業。聲寶旗下桃園龜山物流園區第一期A區已收租，B區預計2027年第1季取得使照交屋，土城橘青春樂齡宅則將於2027年第2季投入營運；三洋電位於新北市的泰山工廠都市計畫變更案亦持續配合內政部通盤檢討審議，逐步建構多元化的營運防護網。
paras_en: The surge in raw material prices driven by AI infrastructure demand and geopolitical factors has kept manufacturing costs for copper, aluminum, iron, plastic pellets and memory chips high. Coupled with weak domestic consumption in Taiwan, the end‑consumer appliance market is poised for a new wave of price hikes to sustain profits. This comes as government subsidies for energy‑saving appliance replacement and reductions in commodity taxes enter their final implementation stage, giving local brands such as Sampo (1604‑TW), Sanyo Electric (1614‑TW) and Heliant (5283‑TW) a chance to improve operations in the second half of the year.

Facing higher upstream costs, Taiwanese appliance companies are generally adopting a dual‑track strategy of freezing price increases to absorb pressure while adjusting prices on new products. The market expects typical items like refrigerators and washing machines to see price rises of about 3%‑5%, with LCD TVs expected to see the most pronounced cost‑pass‑through due to soaring memory‑chip component prices.

Most firms plan to keep current summer‑season pricing for core products, and then gradually raise prices in line with fourth‑quarter new‑product launches, model switches, or the release of new national Level‑1 energy‑efficiency standards, thereby spreading out manufacturing cost pressures.

Regarding individual Taiwanese manufacturers, Sampo’s home‑appliance revenue through August was roughly flat, with sales of freezers, washing machines and LCD TVs standing out, while air‑conditioners grew through Sampo’s two brands, Sampo and Ruis. Sanyo Electric reported combined revenue of NT$2.189 billion for the first five months, down 9.26% year‑on‑year, but expects a turnaround in the second half driven by hot summer demand and year‑end subsidies, aiming to fully recover the first‑half decline.

Heliant projects this year’s performance to be flat to modestly growing versus last year, with its main air‑conditioner line selling about 200,000 units annually and covering high, mid and low price segments through its three brands: Heliant, Sharp and Yamada Air‑Conditioning.

Confronted with mainland‑Chinese brands that undercut prices—pushing 11‑kg washing machines to just over NT$10,000—local and foreign appliance makers are shifting competition toward full‑life‑cycle logistics and service ecosystems.

Taiwanese firms are actively expanding their own logistics warehouses, delivery‑installation networks and nationwide direct‑service repair sites, while introducing high‑efficiency Level‑1 models and medical‑grade equipment. Foreign players such as LG Taiwan also target the 30‑49 age group, promoting rental and regular‑maintenance schemes for air‑conditioners that account for 60% of appliance rentals, thereby building a service moat that price wars cannot easily breach.

To generate long‑term revenue beyond hardware sales, major Taiwanese manufacturers are accelerating moves into real‑estate development and senior‑care services. Sampo’s first‑phase A‑zone of the Taoyuan Guishan logistics park is already leased, with Phase B slated for handover in Q1 2027; its Tucheng “Orange Youth” senior‑living project is expected to start operations in Q2 2027. Sanyo’s Tai‑shan factory redevelopment in New Taipei continues to align with the Ministry of the Interior’s comprehensive review, gradually building a diversified operational safety net.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉中華化受惠電子級硫酸需求強勁 周漲18.3％站上百元大關
items.title_en: <Hot Stock> China Chemical Benefits from Strong Demand for Electronic-Grade Sulfuric Acid in Semiconductor Advanced Processes, Rises 18.3% This Week to Break the NT$100 Barrier
paras: 特用化學廠中華化(1727-TW)受惠於半導體先進製程電子級硫酸需求量強勁，法人預期未來出貨規模可望逐步放大，今(2026)年5月起已經少量出貨，加上半年硫磺及化工原物料價格大漲，推升硫酸、特化產品報價，在業績推波助瀾下，周漲18.3％，日K連收4紅，股價也站上百元大關。
中華化上周在外資連3買支援下，不僅日K連收4紅，股價也站上所有均線之上收106元，創近3個多月來新高，周成交量也來到4.3萬張。
法人指出，中華化旗下電子級硫酸產品，分別供應半導體客戶成熟及先進製程，目前成熟製程供貨穩定，先進製程產線則已於首季通過認證、並開始導入客戶端。
中華化上半年每股稅後純益0.66元、年增翻倍，8月營收2.56億元也創近年單月新高，目前中華化共5條產線運作，電子級硫酸持續取得先進製程認證。
中華化目前還有3家半導體業者正陸續認證中，中華化持續研發其他包括高頻樹脂材料、航太燃油、工程塑料單體應用上。
此外，法人也表示，中華化已取得軍工特化品標案，並將延至第3季出貨，更已取得客戶第2批訂單，未來訂單已能見度持續看佳。
paras_en: Specialty chemical maker China Chemical (1727-TW) is benefiting from robust demand for electronic‑grade sulfuric acid in advanced semiconductor processes. Institutional investors expect shipment volumes to gradually expand; the company has already begun limited shipments in May 2026. Coupled with a sharp rise in sulfur and other chemical raw‑material prices this half‑year, sulfuric acid and specialty product prices have climbed, boosting performance and lifting the stock 18.3% this week. The daily chart posted four consecutive red candles and the price broke the NT$100 mark.

Last week, China Chemical rose above all moving averages to NT$106 with foreign investors buying three consecutive days, posting four straight red candles on the daily chart and hitting a three‑plus‑month high. Weekly turnover reached 43,000 lots.

Institutions note that China Chemical’s electronic‑grade sulfuric acid is supplied to semiconductor customers for both mature and advanced processes. Supply to mature lines remains stable, while the advanced‑process production line passed certification in Q1 and has begun integration at customer sites.

In the first half of the year, China Chemical posted a net profit after tax of NT$0.66 per share, doubling year‑over‑year, and August revenue hit NT$256 million, a recent monthly record. The company now operates five production lines, with electronic‑grade sulfuric acid continuously receiving advanced‑process certifications.

China Chemical is currently undergoing certification with three additional semiconductor firms and continues R&D on other specialty products, including high‑frequency resin materials, aerospace fuel, and engineering‑plastic monomers.

Furthermore, institutions say China Chemical has secured a military‑grade specialty product contract slated for delivery in Q3 and has already received a second batch of orders from the customer, indicating strong future order visibility.

items.title: NASDAQ 100近月強勁彈升！009820勁揚11% 稱霸同類型ETF
items.title_en: NASDAQ 100 Shows Strong Recent Bounce! 009820 Soars 11% Leading Peer ETFs
paras: 美國聯準會 (Fed) 宣布升息 1 碼，鷹派立場使市場重拾對力抗通膨的信心，科技股重返正向反應，國內 NASDAQ ETF 包括元大那斯達克精選(009820-TW)等延續反彈氣勢，領漲美股三大指數。
統計7月底以來反彈至9/17，NASDAQ指數上漲6.2%，領先S&P 500的2.8%，以及道瓊工業指數的-1.8%。至於台股掛牌NASDAQ相關ETF，至9/18，元大納斯達克精選(009820-TW) 上漲11.5%、華南永昌NASDAQxT(009818-TW)上漲8.1%、中信NASDAQ(009800-TW)與富邦NASDAQ(00662-TW)則分別上漲5.9%、5.8%。
法人指出，以上四檔ETF均是以NASDAQ 100指數為基礎，而009820所追蹤的那斯達克100增強成長指數，是NASDAQ 100指數發行40年來首次優化，針對透過毛利率、研發投入、營收成長、獲利成長及市值等多因子篩選成分股，讓指數表現更兼具成長潛力。
NASDAQ 100指數長期為最具代表性的科技主題指數，成分股涵蓋AI晶片、記憶體、資料中心與軟體服務等高成長題材，自2023年AI題材啟動以來，NASDAQ 100累計上漲177%，領先主要美股指數。
展望後市，美國重啟溫和漸進升息，有助緩解市場對未來因追趕通膨，而快速連續升息的擔憂，美債殖利率穩定有利風險性資產重回基本面表現，對利率較敏感的科技股表現可望回溫，在AI長線趨勢未變下，投資人可留意重返新高前的布局機會。

paras_en: The U.S. Federal Reserve announced a 0.25% rate hike, and its hawkish stance restored market confidence in fighting inflation. Tech stocks responded positively again, and domestic NASDAQ ETFs, including Yuanta NASDAQ Select (009820‑TW), continued their rebound momentum, leading gains in the three major U.S. indices.

Since the end of July through September 17, the NASDAQ index rose 6.2%, outpacing the S&P 500’s 2.8% gain and the Dow Jones Industrial Average’s –1.8% decline. As of September 18, Taiwan‑listed NASDAQ‑related ETFs showed: Yuanta NASDAQ Select (009820‑TW) up 11.5%, Hua Nan Yongchang NASDAQxT (009818‑TW) up 8.1%, CTBC NASDAQ (009800‑TW) up 5.9%, and Fubon NASDAQ (00662‑TW) up 5.8%.

Institutions note that all four ETFs track the NASDAQ‑100 index, and the 009820 tracks the NASDAQ‑100 Enhanced Growth Index, the first optimization of the NASDAQ‑100 in its 40‑year history. The index selects constituents via multiple factors—gross margin, R&D spending, revenue growth, earnings growth, and market cap—aiming for stronger growth potential.

The NASDAQ‑100 has long been the flagship tech‑themed index, covering high‑growth themes such as AI chips, memory, data centers, and software services. Since the AI rally began in 2023, the NASDAQ‑100 has gained a cumulative 177%, outpacing major U.S. indices.

Looking ahead, the U.S. is expected to resume a modest, gradual rate‑hike path, easing concerns about rapid, consecutive hikes to chase inflation. Stable U.S. Treasury yields should support risk assets returning to fundamentals, allowing rate‑sensitive tech stocks to warm up again. With the long‑term AI trend unchanged, investors may watch for positioning opportunities before the market retests new highs.
