items.title: Fed卡什卡里：通膨壓力已擴散至美經濟所有領域
items.title_en: Fed's Kashkari: Inflation Pressure Has Spread to All Areas of the U.S. Economy
paras: 美國明尼阿波利斯聯準銀行總裁卡什卡里(Neel Kashkari)周日(20日)表示，美國通膨仍過高，壓力已經超出美伊戰爭導致的油價衝擊，擴散至經濟多個領域。美國人每天感受到的通膨遠不只是油價問題，而是存在於經濟各個層面。
卡什卡里表示，聯準會(Fed)日益擔心通膨並非只集中在受中東衝突或關稅影響的領域，服務業也出現通膨跡象。他並指出，Fed職責是讓通膨回到目標水平，並擁有實現這一目標的工具。
卡什卡里先前是7月維持利率不變決定中的三名反對者之一，當時他傾向於升息，並警告等待時間過長恐導致通膨固化，最終需要採取更激進措施。
卡什卡里認為，美國經濟儘管面臨地緣衝突和貿易問題，仍展現較強韌性，勞動市場維持強勁。他希望隨著部分衝突影響逐漸消退，經濟成長能夠接替推動作用，通膨降溫進程加快，進而降低Fed政策壓力。
paras_en: U.S. Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari said on Sunday (the 20th) that inflation in the United States remains too high, with pressure now exceeding the oil‑price shock caused by the U.S.–Iran conflict and spreading across multiple sectors of the economy. Americans feel inflation every day not just as a fuel‑price issue but as a factor present throughout the economy.

Kashkari noted that the Fed is increasingly worried that inflation is not confined to areas affected by Middle‑East tensions or tariffs, as signs of inflation are also appearing in the services sector. He added that the Fed’s job is to bring inflation back to its target level and that it has the tools to achieve that goal.

Kashkari was previously one of three dissenters in the July decision to keep rates unchanged, favoring a rate hike and warning that waiting too long could allow inflation to become entrenched, eventually requiring more aggressive action.

Kashkari believes that despite geopolitical conflicts and trade issues, the U.S. economy remains relatively resilient, with a strong labor market. He hopes that as the impact of some conflicts wanes, economic growth can take over as the driving force, accelerating the cooling of inflation and thereby easing policy pressure on the Fed.

items.title: 本週操盤筆記：全球PMI、歐亞非多國央行利率決議、川習二會登場
items.title_en: Trading Notes This Week: Global PMI, Multiple Central Bank Rate Decisions Across Europe, Asia and Africa, and the Trump‑Xi Summit
paras: 未來一周，市場將聚焦於標普全球9月採購經理人指數(PMI)初值，以及全球多國央行利率決議。美國9月PMI初值將在周三(23日)出爐，將提供有關當前經濟活動的最新情況，歐元區和英國也將公佈PMI數據，瑞士、瑞典、挪威、墨西哥和南非則將公佈最新利率決議。與此同時，市場正消化聯準會(Fed)上周升息決定，並評估未來進一步升息的前景。
在亞洲，中國將公佈基準貸款利率，印尼央行也將召開利率制定會議。此外，市場也將密切關注美國總統川普與中國大陸國家主席習近平之間的峰會。在美中之間諸多議題中，AI領域競爭以及涉及半導體管制的限制措施恐將影響市場。
1. 全球PMI
美國周三公布的9月製造業和服務業PMI初值料將反映近期油價飆升之下的企業表現，數據中顯現的任何強勁跡象，都可能進一步強化市場對Fed將進一步升息的預期。
ING經濟學家James Knightley在一份報告中寫道：「目前聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)中僅兩位成員認為今年不會再升息，這顯示委員會內部已出現廣泛的鷹派立場調整。」
同日，英國、法國、德國及歐元區9月PMI初值也將出爐，日本PMI初值則預計在周四(24日)發布，而歐元區與法國的9月消費者信心指數初值也將在周二(22日)及周四出爐，尤其值得注意的是周四登場的德國9月Ifo商業景氣指數，以及隔天公佈的德國GfK 10月消費者信心指數。
2. 歐亞非多國利率決議
瑞士央行將於周四宣布最新利率決議，市場普遍預期維持利率在0%不變，因瑞士通膨率仍低。市場將密切關注瑞士央行針對近期能源飆漲的影響、強勢瑞郎以及可能採取的外匯干預措施的任何發言。
同日，北歐國家瑞典與挪威也將公佈利率決議，市場預估將分別維持在1.75%與4.25%不變。野村證券表示，瑞典央行正逐步接近升息，但即使考量近期財政政策變化，通膨率仍低，且經濟展現出越來越強的韌性，第二季GDP成長強勁。

在亞洲，中國人民銀行(央行)周一(21日)將公布貸款一年期與五年期市場報價利率(LPR)，市場將從中尋求進一步貨幣政策支持經濟的跡象。星展銀行經濟學家預估，一年期LPR將維持在3%不變，維持溫和寬鬆的政策立場，因中國強勁出口表現和工業活動將繼續支撐經濟成長。「在此背景下，決策者可能會維持溫和的政策立場，依靠有針對性的財政支持來維持經濟成長，而不是進一步降息。」一年期LPR影響大多數企業和家庭貸款，而五年期LPR則是抵押貸款的基準利率。
法國興業銀行策略師則認為，近期經濟數據強化市場對進一步貨幣政策支持的預期。中國8月零售銷售僅年增0.4%，且今年以來固定資產投資成長放緩至7.2%，工業生產則仍表現亮眼。
周三，印尼央行也將做出最新利率決議，市場預估將維持於5.75%不變。星展銀行經濟學家表示，新上任的印尼央行總裁Destry Damayanti可能會強調全球金融環境緊縮和地緣政治緊張局勢是當前面臨的主要風險，同時指出印尼經濟仍保持相對韌性。
ING經濟學家Deepali Bhargava和Lynn Song則指出，繼8月採取「鴿派」暫停升息舉措，加上在外資資金流入支撐印尼盾近期升值後，印尼央行將按兵不動，但第四季有升息1碼的機率。
同一天，南非央行也可能宣布升息1碼至7.25%，主要因為擔心近期油價飆升恐推高通膨。滙豐銀行經濟學家出具研報指出，油價上漲引發的短期通膨上升、通膨預期不一及發達國家同步升息的趨勢，都為南非央行緊縮貨幣政策提供充分理由。
3. 川習二會
繼今年5月北京峰會後，中國大陸國家主席習近平將於周四(24日)抵達華府，進行十年來首次白宮之行，並會晤美國總統川普。除圍繞台灣和伊朗問題外，此次會晤背景也相當微妙，今年中國貿易順差數字有望創下連兩年超過1兆美元的紀錄，川普則正忙於應對與伊朗的戰爭，以及即將來臨的期中選舉。
paras_en: In the coming week, markets will focus on the S&P Global September Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) flash estimate and rate decisions by several central banks worldwide. The U.S. September PMI flash will be released on Wednesday (the 23rd), providing the latest snapshot of economic activity, while the euro‑area and the United Kingdom will also publish PMI data. Switzerland, Sweden, Norway, Mexico and South Africa are set to announce their latest rate decisions. At the same time, the market is digesting the Fed’s rate‑hike decision from last week and assessing the outlook for further tightening.

In Asia, China will release its benchmark loan rates and Indonesia’s central bank will hold a rate‑setting meeting. Markets will also be closely watching the summit between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping. Among the many U.S.–China issues, competition in AI and semiconductor‑related export controls are likely to affect markets.
This week’s trading notes (09/21‑09/25).
1. Global PMI

The September manufacturing and services PMI flash numbers to be released by the United States on Wednesday are expected to reflect corporate performance amid recent oil‑price spikes. Any signs of strength in the data could further reinforce market expectations that the Fed will continue to raise rates.

ING economist James Knightley wrote in a note: “Only two members of the Federal Open Market Committee currently think there will be no more hikes this year, indicating a broad shift toward a more hawkish stance within the committee.”

On the same day, the United Kingdom, France, Germany and the euro‑area will also release their September PMI flash numbers. Japan’s PMI flash is slated for Thursday (the 24th). The euro‑area and France will publish their September consumer‑confidence flash readings on Tuesday (the 22nd) and Thursday, respectively. Of particular note are Germany’s September Ifo business‑climate index on Thursday and the German GfK October consumer‑confidence index released the following day.
2. Rate decisions across Europe, Asia and Africa

The Swiss National Bank is expected to announce its latest rate decision on Thursday, with markets broadly anticipating that the policy rate will stay at 0% as inflation remains low. Attention will be on any comments regarding the impact of recent energy price surges, the strong franc and possible foreign‑exchange intervention measures.

On the same day, the Nordic countries Sweden and Norway will also publish their rate decisions, with markets forecasting rates to remain unchanged at 1.75% and 4.25% respectively. Nomura says the Swedish central bank is edging closer to a hike, but despite recent fiscal‑policy shifts inflation is still low and the economy is showing increasing resilience, with strong Q2 GDP growth.

In Asia, the People’s Bank of China will publish the one‑year and five‑year Loan Prime Rates (LPR) on Monday (the 21st). Analysts at DBS expect the one‑year LPR to stay at 3%, maintaining a moderately accommodative stance as robust export performance and industrial activity continue to support growth. They note that policymakers are likely to keep a gentle policy stance and rely on targeted fiscal support rather than further cuts. The one‑year LPR affects most corporate and household loans, while the five‑year LPR serves as the benchmark for mortgages.

Société Générale strategists say recent Chinese data reinforce expectations for further monetary support. China’s August retail sales rose only 0.4% year‑on‑year, fixed‑asset investment growth slowed to 7.2% this year, and industrial production remains strong.

On Wednesday, Indonesia’s central bank will announce its latest rate decision, with markets expecting the policy rate to stay unchanged at 5.75%. DBS economists note that the newly appointed governor Destry Damayanti may stress that a tightening global financial environment and geopolitical tensions are the main risks, while also pointing out that Indonesia’s economy remains relatively resilient.

ING economists Deepali Bhargava and Lynn Song say that after the dovish pause in August and recent foreign‑capital inflows that have helped the rupiah appreciate, the central bank is likely to hold steady, though there is a chance of a 0.25‑percentage‑point hike in Q4.

On the same day, the South African Reserve Bank may raise its rate by one basis point to 7.25% due to concerns that recent oil‑price spikes could push inflation higher. HSBC economists argue that the short‑term inflation lift from higher oil, divergent inflation expectations and synchronized rate hikes in advanced economies all give the SARB ample reason to tighten monetary policy.
3. Trump‑Xi summit

Following the May summit in Beijing, Chinese President Xi Jinping will travel to Washington on Thursday (the 24th) for his first White House visit in a decade, meeting U.S. President Donald Trump. In addition to discussions on Taiwan and Iran, the backdrop is delicate: China’s trade surplus is set to exceed $1 trillion for a second consecutive year, while Trump is busy dealing with the war in Iran and the upcoming mid‑term elections.

items.title: 高盛喊年底「全資產上漲」行情！油價、美國期中選舉成最大變數
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Forecasts Year‑End “All‑Asset Rise”; Oil Prices and US Midterm Election the Biggest Variables
paras: 高盛週日（20日）提出的市場展望指出，若美國順利度過國會期中選舉，且油價明顯回落，通膨與升息壓力有望緩解，進而為股市、債市等資產同步上漲創造條件。不過，油價走勢與地緣政治風險仍為這項預期能否實現的關鍵。
高盛的基本邏輯是，油價下跌將推動通膨預期降溫，減輕聯準會（Fed）的升息壓力，甚至為降息創造空間，進一步帶動股票與債券價格同步走高。
高盛先前對2026年整體經濟展望也偏向樂觀，預期全球經濟將受惠於技術創新與區域經濟復甦，聯準會可能在上半年啟動降息，全年降息幅度或達75個基點。
不過，油價走勢可能成為這項「全資產上漲」預期的最大風險。
高盛基準情境假設，2026年第4季中東地緣政治局勢將緩和，航運逐步恢復，並維持布蘭特原油價格每桶80美元的預測。
然而，曾任職於高盛的資深大宗商品策略師Jeff Currie提出截然不同的看法。他警告，美國汽油價格在11月中期選舉前升至每加侖5美元的可能性極高，柴油價格甚至可能攀升至每加侖7至9美元。
Currie認為，能源供應緊張正從成品油市場蔓延至原油供應端。若荷姆茲海峽航運中斷的情況持續至2027年，布蘭特原油價格可能突破每桶120美元。
這也代表，高盛內部對未來油價走勢存在顯著分歧。若地緣政治衝突升溫、油價不降反升，原本建立在通膨降溫與降息預期上的股債齊漲行情，可能轉變為通膨與經濟成長壓力並存下的股債雙跌局面。
除了油價，美國中期選舉本身也可能影響市場走勢。
高盛策略師Ben Snider警告，美股市場可能從8月起逐步感受到中期選舉帶來的衝擊。
歷史資料顯示，自1974年以來的13個美國中期選舉年度，標普500指數從8月初至選舉日的平均報酬率為0%；選舉後3個月的平均漲幅則約為6%。
這項歷史數據顯示，選舉前市場可能面臨震盪，而選舉結果確定後，市場才可能迎來新的行情機會。

油價與美元牽動中國股市表現

對中國市場而言，油價與美國貨幣政策的變化，也可能透過匯率及資金流向產生影響。
若油價回落、聯準會政策轉向寬鬆，美元可能走弱，人民幣升值壓力減輕，進而提高外資回流新興市場的動能。
高盛先前預測，MSCI中國指數與滬深300指數2026年將分別上漲20%與12%。
反之，若油價大幅上漲並推動通膨回升，中國可能面臨輸入性通膨壓力升高，貨幣政策操作空間受到壓縮，進而對A股與港股構成壓力。
整體而言，「全資產上漲」行情能否實現，仍取決於油價、地緣政治與美國中期選舉等多重因素。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs’ market outlook released on Sunday (the 20th) says that if the United States smoothly navigates the congressional midterm elections and oil prices fall markedly, inflation and rate‑hike pressures could ease, creating conditions for stocks, bonds and other assets to rise together. However, the trajectory of oil prices and geopolitical risk remain the key to whether this expectation can be realised.

Goldman’s basic logic is that a drop in oil prices will cool inflation expectations, relieve the Federal Reserve’s pressure to raise rates and even open room for rate cuts, which in turn would lift both equity and bond prices.

Goldman previously took an optimistic view of the overall 2026 economy, expecting the global economy to benefit from technological innovation and regional recoveries, with the Fed possibly starting to cut rates in the first half of the year and delivering a total easing of about 75 basis points for the full year.
Nevertheless, oil‑price movements could become the biggest risk to this “all‑asset rise” outlook.
In Goldman’s baseline scenario, the Middle‑East geopolitical situation is assumed to ease in Q4 2026, shipping gradually recovers and Brent crude is projected to stay at $80 a barrel.

Former Goldman senior commodities strategist Jeff Currie, however, offered a starkly different view. He warned that U.S. gasoline could climb to $5 a gallon before the mid‑November election and diesel could surge to $7‑9 a gallon.
Currie argues that tight energy supply is spreading from refined‑product markets to crude supply. If the Hormuz Strait shipping disruption persists into 2027, Brent could break $120 a barrel.

This indicates a significant split within Goldman over future oil‑price paths. If geopolitical conflict intensifies and oil prices rise instead of falling, the rally in stocks and bonds that rests on cooling inflation and rate‑cut expectations could flip into a dual‑decline scenario with both inflation and growth pressures persisting.
Beyond oil, the U.S. midterm elections themselves could also shape market direction.
Goldman strategist Ben Snider cautioned that the U.S. equity market may begin to feel the impact of the midterms from August onward.

Historical data show that in the 13 midterm election years since 1974, the S&P 500’s average return from early August to election day was 0%, while the average gain in the three months after the election was about 6%.
These figures suggest that markets may be flat or volatile before the election, with new opportunities potentially emerging only after the results are known.
Oil prices and the dollar influence Chinese market performance. For China, changes in oil prices and U.S. monetary policy can affect the market through exchange‑rate movements and capital flows.

If oil prices retreat and the Fed shifts to a more accommodative stance, the dollar could weaken, easing upward pressure on the renminbi and boosting the flow of foreign capital back into emerging markets.
Goldman previously projected that the MSCI China Index and the CSI 300 Index would rise by 20% and 12%, respectively, in 2026.
Conversely, a sharp oil‑price surge that reignites inflation could raise imported‑inflation pressures in China, compressing monetary‑policy space and weighing on A‑shares and Hong Kong stocks.
Overall, whether an “all‑asset rise” materialises will still depend on a mix of oil‑price dynamics, geopolitical developments and the outcome of the U.S. midterm elections.

items.title: AI失控警報再響！谷歌AI首度「越獄」 Gemini自主駭入3家公司
items.title_en: AI Out‑of‑Control Alert Rings Again! Google AI ‘Jails‑Break’ Gemini Hacks Three Companies
paras: 谷歌(GOOGL-US)旗下 Gemini 模型在一次網路安全能力測試中接入網路，並成功駭入三家公司的受保護系統，成為谷歌 AI 系統自主執行此類行動的首個已知案例，也讓外界再度關注 AI 智慧體失控與網路安全風險。
這起事件發生於今年 5 月，由 AI 安全公司 Irregular 在測試 Gemini 網路安全能力期間發現。谷歌直到本週在媒體詢問後，才正式證實相關情況。
測試期間，Gemini 曾在其中一起案例中持續嘗試破解密碼，直到成功進入受保護系統；另外兩起案例則是從公開儲存庫找到登入憑證，進而取得系統存取權限。
不過，谷歌表示，Gemini 在三起事件中判定目標是真實公司的系統後，均自行停止入侵，並未造成相關企業損害。
谷歌安全工程副總裁 Heather Adkins 表示，Gemini 在一次常規測試評估中，抓取網路公開資訊、破解登入憑證，並造訪三個它認為屬於測試範圍的網站。谷歌事後已通知三家受影響公司，也與訓練合作夥伴協調改善測試流程。
Adkins指出，這起事件凸顯訓練強大 AI 模型以負責任方式行動的重要性。
Irregular發言人則表示，這次事件涉及與其他 AI 實驗室相同的問題，所有相關實驗室已在 7 月下旬接獲通知。Irregular隨即採取行動，已知問題也在數週前完成修復與處理。
谷歌認為，這些事件尚未達到必須主動公開披露的程度，原因是 Gemini 並未對相關公司造成損害，而且在發現自己進入的並非模擬環境，而是真實企業系統後，便立刻中止行動。
不過，這並非 AI 智慧體首次意外入侵真實系統。此前，業界也曾發現 OpenAI 的 AI 智慧體入侵 AI 軟體公司 Hugging Face。近期 OpenAI、Anthropic、Meta及谷歌開發的 AI 智慧體系統接連發生類似事件，已引發更廣泛的網路安全疑慮。
Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei近日呼籲產業放慢相關技術的開發速度，OpenAI執行長奧特曼及SpaceX執行長馬斯克等人也表示支持，使AI風險持續上升及如何降低相關威脅，再度成為業界討論焦點。
paras_en: Google’s Gemini model, part of the GOOG‑US portfolio, connected to the internet during a cybersecurity capability test and successfully breached the protected systems of three companies, marking the first known case of a Google AI system autonomously carrying out such actions and reigniting concerns about AI runaway and cyber‑risk.

The incident occurred in May of this year, discovered by AI‑security firm Irregular while testing Gemini’s network‑security abilities. Google only formally confirmed the situation this week after media inquiries.

During the test, Gemini repeatedly attempted password cracking in one case until it gained entry to a protected system; in the other two cases it retrieved login credentials from public repositories and used them to obtain system access.
Google says that after Gemini identified the targets as real company systems in all three incidents, it halted the intrusion on its own and caused no damage to the affected firms.

Google senior vice president of security engineering Heather Adkins said Gemini, in a routine evaluation, harvested publicly available information, cracked login credentials, and visited three sites it deemed within the test scope. Google has since notified the three impacted companies and coordinated with training partners to improve testing procedures.
Adkins noted that the episode underscores the importance of training powerful AI models to act responsibly.

An Irregular spokesperson said the incident reflects a broader issue shared by other AI labs, all of which were notified in late July. Irregular acted quickly, and the known problem was fixed and addressed weeks ago.

Google believes the events do not rise to the level requiring proactive public disclosure because Gemini caused no harm and stopped immediately after realizing it had entered real corporate systems rather than a simulated environment.

However, this is not the first time an AI entity has unintentionally infiltrated a real system. Previously, the industry observed an OpenAI AI infiltrating the AI‑software firm Hugging Face. Recent similar incidents involving AI systems from OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta and Google have sparked wider cybersecurity concerns.

Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei recently urged the industry to slow the pace of related technology development, a sentiment echoed by OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, keeping AI risk and mitigation strategies at the forefront of industry discussion.

items.title: 特斯拉FSD澳紐市場上線周年：碰撞事故率比人開少40%  急煞少90%
items.title_en: Tesla FSD Marks One Year in Australia and New Zealand: Collision Rate 40% Lower Than Human Driving, Hard Braking Down 90%
paras: 特斯拉FSD(監督版)在澳洲、紐西蘭上線滿一周年，該公司在澳紐區官方帳號公布上周三(16日)為止一年車隊數據，啟用FSD期間行駛1.6億公里，對比同樣開啟主動安全的24億公里人工駕駛，整體碰撞事故率降低40%。FSD模式下，平均每178萬公里發生一次碰撞，人工駕駛為每107萬公里一次。
其他高風險操作也明顯減少：自動緊急煞車每1萬7432公里發生一次，較人工的5989公里降66%；急剎每1823公里一次，較人工180公里降90%；猛烈加速降86%，過彎劇烈橫向動作降76%，按喇叭頻次降80%，由人工每643公里一次降至FSD每3233公里一次。
特斯拉強調，FSD仍屬於需駕駛員全程監督的輔助系統，相關數據不宜直接解讀為「完全取代人駕」。
版本方面，澳紐區初期使用v13，今夏已推送v14端到端神經網路架構；v15預計今年底或2027年初推出後再送大洋洲。
老硬體部分，針對HW3的v14 Lite以模型蒸餾精簡神經網路、適配舊處理器，澳紐區版本正加緊研發，目標讓老車在有限算力下維持v14主要功能與安全水準。
全球擴展上，FSD監督版已進入14國，本月稍早斯洛維尼亞批准上路，成歐洲第六個開放市場，歐洲其餘國家陸續放行後推廣可望提速。
特斯拉表示，一年真實車隊數據顯示輔助駕駛在成熟市場可降低事故與激烈操作，但最終安全性仍取決於道路條件、駕駛監督與各地監管標準。
paras_en: Tesla’s Full‑Self‑Driving (FSD) supervised version has been live in Australia and New Zealand for a full year. The company’s official regional account released fleet data up to last Wednesday (the 16th), showing that during the FSD period the cars drove 160 million kilometres. Compared with 2.4 billion kilometres driven under human control with active safety enabled, the overall collision rate was 40% lower. Under FSD a collision occurred on average every 1.78 million kilometres, versus every 1.07 million kilometres for human drivers.

Other high‑risk maneuvers also fell sharply: automatic emergency braking happened once every 17,432 kilometres, a 66% reduction from the human‑driven rate of once every 5,989 kilometres; hard braking occurred once every 1,823 kilometres, a 90% drop from the human rate of once every 180 kilometres; aggressive acceleration fell 86%; severe lateral movements while cornering dropped 76%; and horn usage fell 80%, decreasing from once every 643 kilometres for humans to once every 3,233 kilometres under FSD.
Tesla stresses that FSD remains an assistance system that requires the driver to supervise at all times, and the data should not be interpreted as evidence that it can fully replace human drivers.

In terms of software versions, the Australia‑New Zealand region initially used v13; this summer it rolled out the v14 end‑to‑end neural‑network architecture, and v15 is slated for release either late this year or early 2027 before being pushed to Oceania.

Regarding older hardware, a v14 Lite for HW3 is being developed using model distillation to slim down the neural network and fit legacy processors. The regional team is accelerating development so that older vehicles can retain the core v14 features and safety level despite limited compute capacity.

Globally, the supervised FSD has now entered 14 countries. Earlier this month Slovenia approved its use on public roads, becoming the sixth European market to open up. Further roll‑outs across the rest of Europe are expected to speed up as additional countries grant permission.

Tesla says that a year of real‑world fleet data shows that assisted driving can reduce accidents and aggressive maneuvers in mature markets, but ultimate safety still depends on road conditions, driver supervision and local regulatory standards.

items.title: 科技巨頭炒AI股戰績曝！SpaceX上市、Anthropic估值飆升  但交叉持股暗藏風險
paras: 隨著美國科技巨頭陸續公布最新13F持股申報及季度財報，企業透過股權投資布局人工智慧（AI）產業的成果逐漸浮現。SpaceX(SPCX-US) 上市及AI獨角獸估值重估，推升Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 、輝達(NVDA-US) 等企業的投資資產價值；然而，這種以戰略投資串聯AI產業鏈的模式，也引發市場對估值泡沫及潛在連鎖風險的關注。

輝達持股市值單季增450億美元　英特爾、SpaceX成主要推手

根據最新13F文件，截至6月30日，輝達公開市場股票投資組合市值達634.4億美元，較前季增加450.7億美元，季增245.3%。
輝達持股數量由7檔增至8檔，主要變化來自SpaceX於6月進入二級市場後，原本以非公開股權計算的投資轉列為13F申報持股。
輝達對SpaceX的投資源自早期對xAI的20億美元策略性注資。隨著xAI於今年2月併入SpaceX，相關投資轉換為SpaceX股份，並在6月上市後首度正式揭露。
截至第2季底，輝達持有的SpaceX股權帳面公允價值達209.8億美元，占公開投資組合33.1%，成為第2大持股。
若排除SpaceX的影響，輝達第2季股票投資組合帳面增值仍達240.9億美元，單季報酬率約130%。其中，最大貢獻來自英特爾(INTC-US) 。
文件顯示，截至第2季底，輝達持有英特爾股票的帳面市值達299.9億美元，占公開投資組合47.3%，較前季增加205.1億美元，單季報酬率超過200%。
輝達於去年9月斥資50億美元，透過私募配售認購英特爾2.15億股普通股，並與對方建立技術合作關係。隨著英特爾代工業務進展及財務表現改善，這筆投資在不到1年內為輝達帶來近6倍的帳面增值。
除英特爾與SpaceX外，輝達公開持股還涵蓋CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 、Nebius(YNDX-US) 、Coherent(COHR-US) 、新思科技(SNPS-US) 、諾基亞(NOK-US) 及Generate Biomedicines(GENB-US) 等企業，布局範圍涉及AI雲端、光通訊、電子設計自動化、電信設備及AI醫療等領域。
不過，13F僅反映輝達部分公開市場投資。根據最新10-Q文件，截至7月26日，輝達股權投資總額已達990億美元，較今年1月底的400億美元增加近1.5倍。
其中，非流通股帳面價值為511.6億美元，採用「替代計量法」計算的私募股權帳面價值則為479億美元。輝達對OpenAI及Anthropic的投資，也包含在其非公開股權布局中，兩者合計承諾投資金額達400億美元。

SpaceX上市推升Alphabet持股價值　亞馬遜受惠Anthropic估值重估

Alphabet的公開市場股票投資組合在第2季出現更大幅度的變化。
根據13F文件，截至6月30日，Alphabet公開市場持股市值達990.8億美元，較前季的40.2億美元增加約950億美元，季增幅達2367.45%。
這項增長主要來自SpaceX上市帶來的帳面價值重估。截至第2季底，Alphabet持有SpaceX約5.5億股，帳面價值達942億美元，占其公開投資組合95.1%。
Alphabet早在2015年便向SpaceX投入9億美元種子資金，這筆投資在SpaceX今年6月上市後正式對外揭露，帳面價值大幅攀升。
若排除SpaceX的影響，Alphabet股票投資組合第2季報酬約20%。其餘投資則分散於航太與衛星通訊、金融交易基礎設施及尖端生命科學等領域。
除公開市場持股外，Alphabet截至第2季底的非公開市場股權投資帳面價值達1242.6億美元，當季帳面淨增值773.5億美元，主要受Anthropic估值重估帶動。此外，Alphabet也投資光子運算公司Lightmatter及能源企業Fervo Energy (FRVO-US) 等新創公司。
相較之下，亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 公開市場投資規模較小，但同樣透過AI相關股權布局取得帳面收益。
截至6月30日，亞馬遜公開市場股票持倉市值為44.2億美元，較前季增加68.1%，整體僅持有6檔股票。其中，電動貨車製造商Rivian為最大持股，帳面市值27.5億美元，占比62.1%。
亞馬遜第2季清空生技公司Nautilus Biotechnology (NAUT-US) 持股，轉而加碼清潔核能企業X-Energy(XE-US) 。截至季底，X-Energy帳面市值達12.1億美元，占公開投資組合27.3%。
亞馬遜的非公開股權投資同樣大幅成長。根據10-Q文件，截至第2季底，扣除採權益法計算的非公開市場股權投資帳面價值達1223億美元，較前季增加逾700億美元，較去年底的162億美元則成長逾6倍。
其中，亞馬遜持有的Anthropic無投票權優先股，帳面價值達925億美元，單季增加505億美元。此外，亞馬遜還持有Anthropic可轉換債及OpenAI C輪優先股投資。

微軟透過AI策略投資獲利　OpenAI貢獻逾49億美元稅後利潤

相較於其他科技巨頭，微軟(MSFT-US) 的公開市場股票投資規模相對有限，股權投資主要集中在未上市企業。根據公司10-K文件，截至6月30日，微軟權益投資帳面總額為272.4億美元，其中非公開市場股權投資占245.7億美元，較去年同期增加155億美元。
微軟的非上市股權投資主要分為不同類別，其中一部分採用「替代計量法」計算，帳面價值達124億美元，年增95億美元，主要涉及Anthropic、Inflection AI等私人企業的策略性持股及估值重估。
另一部分則採用權益法計算，帳面價值為120億美元，較去年同期增加60億美元，主要來自對OpenAI的策略性投資。
截至2026年6月底，微軟投資OpenAI的淨收益達65.3億美元，去年同期則為虧損47.6億美元。該項投資在2026會計年度為微軟帶來49.6億美元稅後淨利，占公司全年淨利約3.7%。
此外，微軟權益投資中，另有約1.7億美元資產採用資產淨值（NAV）公允價值法計算。

AI交叉持股放大收益　估值回落恐引發連鎖效應

綜合來看，科技巨頭第2季股權投資價值大幅攀升，主要受惠於SpaceX上市，以及Anthropic、OpenAI等AI獨角獸估值重估。
其中，SpaceX上市為Google、輝達帶來可觀的帳面增值，Anthropic估值上調則推升Google、亞馬遜等早期投資者的持股價值，成為科技巨頭資產及獲利成長的重要推力。
與此同時，科技巨頭的投資策略已從單純追求財務回報，轉向掌握AI供應鏈與生態系。各大企業透過股權投資、算力採購及技術合作，將AI新創、雲端服務商與晶片業者串聯起來。
AI新創取得資金後，轉化為GPU晶片及雲端算力訂單，推升科技巨頭的本業營收；新創估值上升，也能同步增加巨頭的投資收益，形成資金、訂單與估值相互推升的循環。
不過，這種高度交織的投資模式也存在反轉風險。一旦AI商業化進度不如預期，或市場對AI企業的估值下修，科技巨頭可能同時面臨訂單減少、持股減損及資本支出縮減等壓力。
若資金挹注持續減少，AI新創的估值與業務拓展也可能受到衝擊，並進一步引發整條AI產業鏈的連鎖收縮。

items.title: 甲骨文180億美元AI貸款陷分銷困境！資料中心融資風險浮現
items.title_en: Oracle’s $18 Billion AI Loan Faces Distribution Trouble! Data Center Financing Risks Surface
paras: 人工智慧（AI）基礎建設投資熱潮持續之際，甲骨文(ORCL-US) 一筆規模達180億美元的資料中心聯貸交易，傳出因折價出售而陷入分銷困境。市場對這筆貸款的定價變化，凸顯AI資料中心建設進度、企業舉債規模及未來現金流之間的矛盾，也引發外界對AI產業融資模式的關注。
根據《金融時報》與《華爾街日報》報導，甲骨文位於美國新墨西哥州的Project Jupiter資料中心，涉及約180億美元的銀團貸款。
這筆貸款目前由桑坦德銀行（Santander）及Jefferies等牽頭銀行，以每1美元面額89至91美分的價格報價，對應市值約160億至164億美元，較原始面額折價近10%。
這筆貸款於去年底發放，當時的承銷邏輯建立在甲骨文與OpenAI簽訂的3,000億美元、為期5年的雲端合約之上，並以投資級信用條件作為假設。
然而，目前市場報價所反映的殖利率，已接近單一B級信用債務的水準，顯示投資人對這筆貸款的風險評估出現變化。
一家固定收益研究機構的歐洲信用策略主管Marta Villegas表示，貸款機構如今關注的已不再只是OpenAI合約本身，而是資料中心的建設進度。在新墨西哥州設施完成通電並開始產生營收之前，貸款抵押品主要仍是硬體設備及相關許可。
由於貸款分銷進度陷入停滯，銀行必須在資產負債表上保留超出原定計畫的甲骨文債務曝險。

信用評等逼近垃圾級 槓桿與現金流承壓

甲骨文目前的財務狀況，也成為市場重新檢視其AI基礎建設融資能力的重要因素。
2026年7月，標準普爾（S&P）將甲骨文信用評等下調至BBB-，距離垃圾級的評等僅差一級。惠譽（Fitch）則給予甲骨文BBB評等，並警告若公司槓桿持續高於門檻，可能採取負面評等行動。
根據相關資料，甲骨文目前債務規模約1,295億美元，債務與EBITDA比率約4.3倍。相較之下，Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 及Meta(META-US) 的同項比率均低於1倍。
穆迪（Moody's）目前維持甲骨文Baa2評等，但展望為負面。該機構指出，其他大型AI基礎建設供應商並未以同樣高的槓桿水準及負自由現金流，投入目前這一輪投資週期。
甲骨文的資本支出壓力也持續升高。公司2026會計年度資本支出約556億美元，高於原先設定的500億美元目標；2027會計年度資本支出指引進一步上調至900億至950億美元。與此同時，公司自由現金流已轉為負值，預計淨負債將突破1,050億美元。
信用違約交換（CDS）市場同樣反映出相關疑慮。甲骨文5年期CDS利差已擴大至約203個基點，接近2008年以來的高點。
摩根大通此前也推出涵蓋甲骨文在內的5家超大規模雲端服務商CDS籃子，供機構投資人用於避險或押注AI相關信用風險。
此外，甲骨文2026年1月遭債券持有人集體提告。原告指控，公司在發行180億美元債券時，未揭露未來需要大規模舉債建設AI基礎設施的計畫，涉及「虛假及誤導性」陳述。

Project Jupiter建設受阻 延宕恐加劇資金壓力

Project Jupiter位於新墨西哥州Doña Ana郡，占地約1,400英畝，原先規劃以2.2吉瓦燃氣渦輪機供電。然而，州土地辦公室阻止天然氣管道鋪設申請，迫使甲骨文改採再生能源方案，進而改變工程時程及成本結構。
當地社區對水資源及空氣品質的疑慮，也為資料中心開發增添阻力。甲骨文在德州及威斯康辛州的規劃據點，同樣面臨法律挑戰及延長的公眾評論程序。
相關分析指出，資料中心若延遲完工，營收認列時間便會往後推遲，但利息支出仍會持續累積，形成建設進度與融資成本之間的落差。
甲骨文在德州、威斯康辛州及新墨西哥州的規劃據點，估計合計需要約560億美元融資，其中德州及威斯康辛州約占380億美元。此外，公司據報計畫在本會計年度再融資超過400億美元的債務及股權。

AI融資熱潮擴大 市場承接能力面臨考驗

甲骨文的融資困境，也與AI產業整體資金需求快速膨脹有關。
《金融時報》報導，OpenAI在7月的一份內部簡報中披露，預計2026年至2030年間累計自由現金流將為負2,780億美元。公司營收預估將從2026年的360億美元，增加至2030年的3,500億美元，但算力及基礎建設支出仍將大幅超過營收規模。
OpenAI是甲骨文最大的AI客戶之一。相關財務預期也讓市場開始關注，OpenAI未來履行3,000億美元雲端合約時，實際付款的時間及資金品質是否能符合原先假設。
與此同時，美國5大雲端運算公司的2026年資本支出指引合計超過7,500億美元，2027年預計突破1.1兆美元。摩根大通預估，未來5年投資級企業信用市場將為資料中心提供超過2.1兆美元融資，高收益債及槓桿貸款則可能額外貢獻約3,500億美元。
不過，市場吸收這些融資的能力正受到考驗。2026年上半年，AI相關融資占投資級公司債發行量的34%，占高收益債發行量的40%。債券認購覆蓋倍數也從2月接近5倍，降至7月不到2倍，顯示密集的企業債發行可能正在消耗市場承接空間。
早在5月，摩根大通、摩根士丹利及三菱日聯金融集團等銀行，便開始尋求透過出售私人貸款及重大風險轉移等方式，降低資料中心相關債務曝險。
甲骨文相關貸款的分銷工作，據報已持續超過6個月仍未完成。
另一方面，《華爾街日報》報導，Anthropic原定於10月進行的首次公開募股（IPO），計畫延後至11月。知情人士表示，AI產業幾家大型企業的負責人呼籲放慢技術發展步伐，是延期原因之一。

華爾街多空分歧 聚焦甲骨文轉型與債務壓力

面對甲骨文的AI基礎建設布局，華爾街分析師的看法並不一致，市場爭論主要圍繞公司能否在債務壓力升高之前，將AI投資轉化為實際營收及現金流。
摩根大通分析師Samik Chatterjee維持甲骨文「加碼」評級及200美元目標價。他認為，投資人仍將甲骨文視為成熟的軟體公司，低估其轉型為AI基礎建設供應商的潛力。
摩根大通預估，甲骨文雲端基礎設施營收將從2026會計年度的180億美元，增至2030會計年度的1,800億美元，並認為市場目前對公司短期融資風險的關注程度過高。
花旗分析師Tyler Radke則維持甲骨文「買進」評級及330美元目標價，將股價先前的下跌歸因於投資人恐慌及信用市場壓力，並認為強制性拋售的影響已經消退。
另一方面，知名放空投資人、《大賣空》原型貝瑞（Michael Burry）據報增加甲骨文的放空部位。他預測，到2028年AI算力可能供過於求，並認為甲骨文依賴債務為AI基礎建設融資的模式，已為這波AI熱潮埋下時間壓力。
甲骨文2027會計年度資本支出預計高達950億美元，未來資料中心租賃承諾則約為2,600億美元。
paras_en: While the AI infrastructure investment boom continues, Oracle (ORCL-US) has a $18 billion data center syndication that is reportedly facing distribution difficulties due to a discount sale. The market’s pricing changes for this loan highlight the contradictions between AI data center construction progress, corporate borrowing scale, and future cash flows, and have drawn attention to AI industry financing models.
According to reports from the Financial Times and the Wall Street Journal, Oracle’s Project Jupiter data center in New Mexico, USA, involves a syndicate loan of about $18 billion.

The loan is currently led by Santander and Jefferies, quoted at 89 to 91 cents per $1 face value, corresponding to a market value of roughly $16 billion to $16.4 billion, a discount of nearly 10% from the original face amount.
The loan was disbursed at the end of last year, based on Oracle’s $300 billion, five‑year cloud contract with OpenAI, assuming investment‑grade credit terms.
However, the yield reflected in current market pricing is approaching the level of a single B‑grade debt, indicating a shift in investors’ risk assessment of the loan.

A fixed‑income research firm’s European credit strategy head, Marta Villegas, said that lenders now focus not just on the OpenAI contract itself but on the data center’s construction progress. Until the New Mexico facility is energized and starts generating revenue, the loan’s collateral remains primarily hardware equipment and related permits.
Because the loan distribution has stalled, banks must retain Oracle debt exposure on their balance sheets beyond the original plan.
Oracle’s current financial condition has become a key factor for the market’s reassessment of its AI infrastructure financing capacity.

In July 2026, Standard & Poor’s lowered Oracle’s credit rating to BBB‑, just one notch from junk status. Fitch gave Oracle a BBB rating and warned that continued high leverage could trigger a negative rating action.
Oracle’s debt is about $129.5 billion, with a debt‑to‑EBITDA ratio of roughly 4.3×. In contrast, Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Meta (META‑US) have ratios below 1×.

Moody’s maintains Oracle’s Baa2 rating but with a negative outlook, noting that other large AI infrastructure vendors have not taken on the same high leverage and negative free cash flow in this investment cycle.

Oracle’s capital‑expenditure pressure continues to rise. The company’s 2026 fiscal year capex is about $55.6 billion, above the previously set $50 billion target; the 2027 fiscal year capex guidance is further raised to $90 billion to $95 billion. Meanwhile, free cash flow has turned negative, with net debt expected to exceed $105 billion.
The credit‑default‑swap (CDS) market also reflects related concerns. Oracle’s five‑year CDS spread has widened to about 203 basis points, close to the high seen since 2008.
J.P. Morgan previously launched a CDS basket covering five large‑scale cloud service providers, including Oracle, for institutional investors to hedge or bet on AI‑related credit risk.

In addition, Oracle was sued by bondholders in January 2026. Plaintiffs alleged that the company failed to disclose plans for large‑scale borrowing to build AI infrastructure when issuing the $18 billion bond, constituting “false and misleading” statements.

Project Jupiter’s construction is stalled, potentially worsening funding pressure. The project, located in Doña Ana County, New Mexico, covers about 1,400 acres and was originally planned to be powered by a 2.2 GW gas turbine. However, the state land office blocked the natural‑gas pipeline application, forcing Oracle to switch to a renewable energy solution, which altered the engineering schedule and cost structure.

Local community concerns over water resources and air quality have added resistance to data center development. Oracle’s planned sites in Texas and Wisconsin face similar legal challenges and extended public comment procedures.

Analysts note that if the data center is delayed, revenue recognition will be postponed, but interest expenses will continue to accrue, creating a gap between construction progress and financing costs.

Oracle’s planned sites in Texas, Wisconsin and New Mexico are estimated to require a combined $56 billion in financing, with Texas and Wisconsin accounting for about $38 billion. The company also plans to refinance over $40 billion of debt and equity in the current fiscal year.
Oracle’s financing dilemma is also linked to the rapid expansion of overall AI industry funding needs.

The Financial Times reported that OpenAI’s internal briefing in July disclosed that cumulative free cash flow from 2026 to 2030 would be negative $278 billion. Revenue is projected to rise from $36 billion in 2026 to $350 billion in 2030, but computing and infrastructure spend will still far exceed revenue scale.

OpenAI is one of Oracle’s largest AI customers. These financial expectations have prompted the market to question whether OpenAI’s future fulfillment of the $300 billion cloud contract will meet the original payment timing and quality assumptions.

Meanwhile, the 2026 capital‑expenditure guidance for the five largest U.S. cloud providers totals over $750 billion, with 2027 expected to exceed $1.1 trillion. J.P. Morgan estimates that the next five years of investment‑grade corporate credit will provide over $2.1 trillion in financing for data centers, with high‑yield bonds and leveraged loans potentially adding another $350 billion.

However, the market’s absorption capacity is being tested. In the first half of 2026, AI‑related financing accounted for 34% of investment‑grade corporate bond issuance and 40% of high‑yield bond issuance. The bond subscription coverage ratio fell from nearly 5× in February to less than 2× in July, indicating that dense corporate bond issuance may be eroding market appetite.
In May, banks such as J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley and Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group began seeking to reduce data‑center‑related debt exposure through private loan sales and major risk transfers.
Oracle’s loan distribution work has reportedly been ongoing for over six months without completion.

On the other hand, the Wall Street Journal reported that Anthropic’s planned IPO in October was postponed to November. Insiders say that several large AI companies’ leaders urged a slowdown in technology development, which was one reason for the delay.

Wall Street’s bullish and bearish views diverge, focusing on Oracle’s transformation and debt pressure. Analysts debate whether the company can convert AI investment into actual revenue and cash flow before debt pressure rises further.

J.P. Morgan analyst Samik Chatterjee maintains an “overweight” rating for Oracle with a $200 target price. He believes investors still view Oracle as a mature software company, underestimating its potential to transform into an AI infrastructure provider.

J.P. Morgan projects Oracle’s cloud infrastructure revenue to rise from $18 billion in the 2026 fiscal year to $180 billion in the 2030 fiscal year, and believes the market’s current focus on short‑term financing risk is over‑stressed.

Citigroup analyst Tyler Radke keeps an “buy” rating for Oracle with a $330 target price, attributing the recent share price decline to investor panic and credit‑market pressure, and believes forced selling has subsided.

Meanwhile, well‑known short‑seller and author of “The Big Short,” Michael Burry, reportedly increased his short position in Oracle. He predicts that by 2028 AI computing power may be oversupplied, and believes Oracle’s debt‑based AI infrastructure financing model has planted time pressure for this AI boom.
Oracle’s 2027 fiscal year capital expenditure is expected to reach $95 billion, with future data‑center lease commitments of about $260 billion.

items.title: AI四巨頭遭起訴！Anthropic「AI放緩論」涉非法商業合謀、違反美國反壟斷法？
items.title_en: Four AI Giants Sued! Anthropic's "AI Slowdown Theory" Involved in Illegal Commercial Conspiracy, Violating US Antitrust Law?
paras: 人工智慧（AI）產業的監管爭議正從政策討論延伸至法律層面。據報，4名原告近日在加州聯邦法院提起民事訴訟，指控Anthropic、OpenAI、xAI及Google(GOOGL-US) 涉嫌違反美國反壟斷法，透過公開協調放緩AI發展速度，構成非法商業合謀。
根據《POLITICO》報導，這起訴訟的導火線，是Anthropic執行長阿莫戴（Dario Amodei）本月稍早發表的一篇文章。
他在文中呼籲AI產業「協調行動」，以「控制AI尖端技術的發展步調」。這項主張隨後獲得xAI負責人馬斯克、OpenAI執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）及Google DeepMind共同創辦人哈薩比斯（Demis Hassabis）公開附議。
原告認為，相關公開表態已構成競爭對手之間的非法商業協議。案件若進入實質審理階段，可能牽動AI產業的競爭格局及監管方向。
這起訴訟是在加州北區聯邦地方法院提出。原告代理律師之一Nick Rowley在聲明中表示，提告目的是防止「全球最具影響力的營利科技公司之間，基於自身利益達成的私下協議」，導致AI「迅速脫離人類控制」。
Rowley指出，面對核戰爭等可能威脅人類存續的風險，人類應獲得明確且可靠的保障；相關法律規範則應由政府透過透明、合法且對公眾負責的程序建立。
原告的法律主張在於，即使相關表態是以公共安全為出發點，但阿莫戴的公開倡議，以及其他AI產業領袖的回應，可能構成競爭對手就商業行為達成協議，進而觸及美國反壟斷法規範。
這起訴訟的背景，是AI安全議題持續引發討論。近期包括現任及前任AI研究人員均發出警告，認為如果缺乏充分的安全防護措施，AI技術持續發展可能對人類生存構成重大威脅。
相關產業領袖提出放緩AI尖端技術發展的主張，正是在這一背景下出現。
不過，這起訴訟將原本聚焦於AI安全的討論，轉化為反壟斷法律爭議。原告並非否定AI可能帶來的安全風險，而是主張，無論企業出於何種動機，競爭對手之間的協調行為都不應免於法律監督。
原告並在訴狀中強調，涉及AI發展速度及安全規範的決策，應透過政府透明的制度與程序推動，而不應由企業私下協調主導。
4名原告的背景各不相同。其中，律師Cheyenne Hunt過去曾參與揭露前加州聯邦眾議員Eric Swalwell及前緬因州參議員候選人Graham Platner涉及性行為不當的指控。
另外兩名原告為佛羅里達州律師Charles Buist及Nick Spetsas，第4名原告則是加州居民Christine Bullock。
訴訟文件顯示，原告有意將案件擴大為集體訴訟，代表所有受到相關企業放緩AI發展決策影響的群體。若此一訴求獲准，案件涉及的潛在索賠範圍可能擴大。
paras_en: Regulatory disputes in the AI industry are moving from policy discussions to the legal arena. According to reports, four plaintiffs recently filed a civil lawsuit in a federal court in California, accusing Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI and Google (GOOGL-US) of violating US antitrust law by publicly coordinating to slow the pace of AI development, constituting illegal commercial collusion.
According to POLITICO, the spark for the lawsuit was an article published earlier this month by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei.

In the piece he called for the AI industry to "coordinate actions" to "control the pace of development of cutting‑edge AI technology." The proposal was subsequently publicly endorsed by xAI head Elon Musk, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, and DeepMind co‑founder Demis Hassabis.

The plaintiffs argue that the public statements amount to an illegal commercial agreement among competitors. If the case proceeds to trial, it could affect the competitive landscape and regulatory direction of the AI sector.

The suit was filed in the Northern District of California federal court. One of the plaintiffs' attorneys, Nick Rowley, said in a statement that the purpose of the filing is to prevent "private agreements between the world’s most influential for‑profit tech companies, based on their own interests," that could cause AI to "rapidly get out of human control."

Rowley noted that faced with existential risks such as nuclear war, humanity must have clear and reliable safeguards; related legal rules should be established by the government through transparent, lawful, and publicly accountable procedures.

The plaintiffs’ legal claim is that even if the statements are framed as public‑safety concerns, Amodei’s public advocacy and the responses of other AI leaders may constitute an agreement among competitors on business conduct, thereby violating US antitrust statutes.

The lawsuit comes against a backdrop of ongoing debate over AI safety. Recently, both current and former AI researchers have warned that without adequate safety measures, continued AI development could pose a major threat to human survival.
Industry leaders’ calls to slow the development of cutting‑edge AI technologies have emerged in this context.

However, the lawsuit reframes the discussion that was originally focused on AI safety into an antitrust dispute. The plaintiffs do not deny the potential safety risks of AI, but argue that regardless of corporate motives, coordinated behavior among competitors should not be exempt from legal oversight.
The complaint emphasizes that decisions about AI development speed and safety standards should be driven through transparent government processes, not by private corporate coordination.

The four plaintiffs have diverse backgrounds. Among them, attorney Cheyenne Hunt previously helped expose allegations of sexual misconduct involving former California federal Representative Eric Swalwell and former Maine Senate candidate Graham Platner.
The other two plaintiffs are Florida attorneys Charles Buist and Nick Spetsas, and the fourth plaintiff is California resident Christine Bullock.

Court documents show the plaintiffs intend to expand the case into a class action representing all groups affected by the companies’ decisions to slow AI development. If that request is granted, the potential scope of claims could broaden significantly.

items.title: Fed卡什卡里：通膨壓力已擴散至美經濟所有領域
items.title_en: Fed's Kashkari: Inflation Pressure Has Spread to All Areas of the U.S. Economy
paras: 美國明尼阿波利斯聯準銀行總裁卡什卡里(Neel Kashkari)周日(20日)表示，美國通膨仍過高，壓力已經超出美伊戰爭導致的油價衝擊，擴散至經濟多個領域。美國人每天感受到的通膨遠不只是油價問題，而是存在於經濟各個層面。
卡什卡里表示，聯準會(Fed)日益擔心通膨並非只集中在受中東衝突或關稅影響的領域，服務業也出現通膨跡象。他並指出，Fed職責是讓通膨回到目標水平，並擁有實現這一目標的工具。
卡什卡里先前是7月維持利率不變決定中的三名反對者之一，當時他傾向於升息，並警告等待時間過長恐導致通膨固化，最終需要採取更激進措施。
卡什卡里認為，美國經濟儘管面臨地緣衝突和貿易問題，仍展現較強韌性，勞動市場維持強勁。他希望隨著部分衝突影響逐漸消退，經濟成長能夠接替推動作用，通膨降溫進程加快，進而降低Fed政策壓力。
paras_en: U.S. Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari said on Sunday (the 20th) that inflation in the United States remains too high, with pressure now exceeding the oil‑price shock caused by the U.S.–Iran conflict and spreading across multiple sectors of the economy. Americans feel inflation every day not just as a fuel‑price issue but as a factor present throughout the economy.

Kashkari noted that the Fed is increasingly worried that inflation is not confined to areas affected by Middle‑East tensions or tariffs, as signs of inflation are also appearing in the services sector. He added that the Fed’s job is to bring inflation back to its target level and that it has the tools to achieve that goal.

Kashkari was previously one of three dissenters in the July decision to keep rates unchanged, favoring a rate hike and warning that waiting too long could allow inflation to become entrenched, eventually requiring more aggressive action.

Kashkari believes that despite geopolitical conflicts and trade issues, the U.S. economy remains relatively resilient, with a strong labor market. He hopes that as the impact of some conflicts wanes, economic growth can take over as the driving force, accelerating the cooling of inflation and thereby easing policy pressure on the Fed.

items.title: 俄羅斯首都莫斯科 遭遇有史以來最大規模襲擊
items.title_en: Russia's capital Moscow suffers its largest-ever attack
paras: 俄羅斯首都莫斯科市市長索比亞寧20日（周日）表示，莫斯科市當天遭遇史上最大規模襲擊，烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基在社交平台X發帖，就襲擊行動表態。
澤倫斯基20日在帖文中表示，烏克蘭昨晚對莫斯科地區的遠程打擊產生非常重大的影響，俄羅斯一個重要石油工業設施和後勤設施被擊中。
烏克蘭武裝部隊總參謀部通報，20日凌晨烏軍攻擊莫斯科煉油廠，煉油廠區域發生大規模火災，AVT-6初級煉油裝置、綜合原油加工裝置等遭到打擊。
烏軍稱，莫斯科煉油廠是俄羅斯最大煉油企業之一，年原油加工能力約1,200萬噸，生產車用汽油、柴油、航空燃料、重油等石油產品。烏方說，該煉油廠參與確保俄羅斯武裝力量需求。
據俄羅斯官員20日消息，莫斯科市和莫斯科州當天遭無人機襲擊。索比亞寧在社交媒體上說，19日以來共擊落1,600多架無人機，其中450架是在逼近莫斯科時被擊落。
據《美聯社》報導，索比亞寧將這波無人機襲擊描述為首都遭遇的有史以來最大規模襲擊，並表示莫斯科一家煉油廠和一棟居民樓遭到破壞。
paras_en: Moscow mayor Sobyanin said on Sunday the 20th that Moscow experienced the largest-scale attack in history, and Ukrainian President Zelensky posted on X about the attack.

In his post on the 20th, Zelensky said Ukraine's remote strike on the Moscow region last night had a very significant impact, hitting an important Russian oil industrial facility and a logistics facility.

The Ukrainian Armed Forces General Staff reported that in the early hours of the 20th Ukrainian forces attacked a Moscow refinery, causing a large fire in the refinery area, damaging the AVT-6 primary refining unit and integrated crude oil processing unit, among others.

Ukrainian forces said the Moscow refinery is one of Russia's largest refining companies, with an annual crude processing capacity of about 12 million tonnes, producing motor gasoline, diesel, aviation fuel, heavy oil and other petroleum products. The Ukrainian side said the refinery helps meet the needs of the Russian armed forces.

According to Russian officials on the 20th, Moscow city and Moscow region were attacked by drones that day. Sobyanin said on social media that since the 19th more than 1,600 drones have been shot down, including 450 that were downed as they approached Moscow.

The Associated Press reported that Sobyanin described this wave of drone attacks as the largest-scale attack ever suffered by the capital, and said a Moscow refinery and a residential building were damaged.

items.title: 本週操盤筆記：全球PMI、歐亞非多國央行利率決議、川習二會登場
items.title_en: Trading Notes This Week: Global PMI, Multiple Central Bank Rate Decisions Across Europe, Asia and Africa, and the Trump‑Xi Summit
paras: 未來一周，市場將聚焦於標普全球9月採購經理人指數(PMI)初值，以及全球多國央行利率決議。美國9月PMI初值將在周三(23日)出爐，將提供有關當前經濟活動的最新情況，歐元區和英國也將公佈PMI數據，瑞士、瑞典、挪威、墨西哥和南非則將公佈最新利率決議。與此同時，市場正消化聯準會(Fed)上周升息決定，並評估未來進一步升息的前景。
在亞洲，中國將公佈基準貸款利率，印尼央行也將召開利率制定會議。此外，市場也將密切關注美國總統川普與中國大陸國家主席習近平之間的峰會。在美中之間諸多議題中，AI領域競爭以及涉及半導體管制的限制措施恐將影響市場。
1. 全球PMI
美國周三公布的9月製造業和服務業PMI初值料將反映近期油價飆升之下的企業表現，數據中顯現的任何強勁跡象，都可能進一步強化市場對Fed將進一步升息的預期。
ING經濟學家James Knightley在一份報告中寫道：「目前聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)中僅兩位成員認為今年不會再升息，這顯示委員會內部已出現廣泛的鷹派立場調整。」
同日，英國、法國、德國及歐元區9月PMI初值也將出爐，日本PMI初值則預計在周四(24日)發布，而歐元區與法國的9月消費者信心指數初值也將在周二(22日)及周四出爐，尤其值得注意的是周四登場的德國9月Ifo商業景氣指數，以及隔天公佈的德國GfK 10月消費者信心指數。
2. 歐亞非多國利率決議
瑞士央行將於周四宣布最新利率決議，市場普遍預期維持利率在0%不變，因瑞士通膨率仍低。市場將密切關注瑞士央行針對近期能源飆漲的影響、強勢瑞郎以及可能採取的外匯干預措施的任何發言。
同日，北歐國家瑞典與挪威也將公佈利率決議，市場預估將分別維持在1.75%與4.25%不變。野村證券表示，瑞典央行正逐步接近升息，但即使考量近期財政政策變化，通膨率仍低，且經濟展現出越來越強的韌性，第二季GDP成長強勁。

在亞洲，中國人民銀行(央行)周一(21日)將公布貸款一年期與五年期市場報價利率(LPR)，市場將從中尋求進一步貨幣政策支持經濟的跡象。星展銀行經濟學家預估，一年期LPR將維持在3%不變，維持溫和寬鬆的政策立場，因中國強勁出口表現和工業活動將繼續支撐經濟成長。「在此背景下，決策者可能會維持溫和的政策立場，依靠有針對性的財政支持來維持經濟成長，而不是進一步降息。」一年期LPR影響大多數企業和家庭貸款，而五年期LPR則是抵押貸款的基準利率。
法國興業銀行策略師則認為，近期經濟數據強化市場對進一步貨幣政策支持的預期。中國8月零售銷售僅年增0.4%，且今年以來固定資產投資成長放緩至7.2%，工業生產則仍表現亮眼。
周三，印尼央行也將做出最新利率決議，市場預估將維持於5.75%不變。星展銀行經濟學家表示，新上任的印尼央行總裁Destry Damayanti可能會強調全球金融環境緊縮和地緣政治緊張局勢是當前面臨的主要風險，同時指出印尼經濟仍保持相對韌性。
ING經濟學家Deepali Bhargava和Lynn Song則指出，繼8月採取「鴿派」暫停升息舉措，加上在外資資金流入支撐印尼盾近期升值後，印尼央行將按兵不動，但第四季有升息1碼的機率。
同一天，南非央行也可能宣布升息1碼至7.25%，主要因為擔心近期油價飆升恐推高通膨。滙豐銀行經濟學家出具研報指出，油價上漲引發的短期通膨上升、通膨預期不一及發達國家同步升息的趨勢，都為南非央行緊縮貨幣政策提供充分理由。
3. 川習二會
繼今年5月北京峰會後，中國大陸國家主席習近平將於周四(24日)抵達華府，進行十年來首次白宮之行，並會晤美國總統川普。除圍繞台灣和伊朗問題外，此次會晤背景也相當微妙，今年中國貿易順差數字有望創下連兩年超過1兆美元的紀錄，川普則正忙於應對與伊朗的戰爭，以及即將來臨的期中選舉。
paras_en: In the coming week, markets will focus on the S&P Global September Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) flash estimate and rate decisions by several central banks worldwide. The U.S. September PMI flash will be released on Wednesday (the 23rd), providing the latest snapshot of economic activity, while the euro‑area and the United Kingdom will also publish PMI data. Switzerland, Sweden, Norway, Mexico and South Africa are set to announce their latest rate decisions. At the same time, the market is digesting the Fed’s rate‑hike decision from last week and assessing the outlook for further tightening.

In Asia, China will release its benchmark loan rates and Indonesia’s central bank will hold a rate‑setting meeting. Markets will also be closely watching the summit between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping. Among the many U.S.–China issues, competition in AI and semiconductor‑related export controls are likely to affect markets.
This week’s trading notes (09/21‑09/25).
1. Global PMI

The September manufacturing and services PMI flash numbers to be released by the United States on Wednesday are expected to reflect corporate performance amid recent oil‑price spikes. Any signs of strength in the data could further reinforce market expectations that the Fed will continue to raise rates.

ING economist James Knightley wrote in a note: “Only two members of the Federal Open Market Committee currently think there will be no more hikes this year, indicating a broad shift toward a more hawkish stance within the committee.”

On the same day, the United Kingdom, France, Germany and the euro‑area will also release their September PMI flash numbers. Japan’s PMI flash is slated for Thursday (the 24th). The euro‑area and France will publish their September consumer‑confidence flash readings on Tuesday (the 22nd) and Thursday, respectively. Of particular note are Germany’s September Ifo business‑climate index on Thursday and the German GfK October consumer‑confidence index released the following day.
2. Rate decisions across Europe, Asia and Africa

The Swiss National Bank is expected to announce its latest rate decision on Thursday, with markets broadly anticipating that the policy rate will stay at 0% as inflation remains low. Attention will be on any comments regarding the impact of recent energy price surges, the strong franc and possible foreign‑exchange intervention measures.

On the same day, the Nordic countries Sweden and Norway will also publish their rate decisions, with markets forecasting rates to remain unchanged at 1.75% and 4.25% respectively. Nomura says the Swedish central bank is edging closer to a hike, but despite recent fiscal‑policy shifts inflation is still low and the economy is showing increasing resilience, with strong Q2 GDP growth.

In Asia, the People’s Bank of China will publish the one‑year and five‑year Loan Prime Rates (LPR) on Monday (the 21st). Analysts at DBS expect the one‑year LPR to stay at 3%, maintaining a moderately accommodative stance as robust export performance and industrial activity continue to support growth. They note that policymakers are likely to keep a gentle policy stance and rely on targeted fiscal support rather than further cuts. The one‑year LPR affects most corporate and household loans, while the five‑year LPR serves as the benchmark for mortgages.

Société Générale strategists say recent Chinese data reinforce expectations for further monetary support. China’s August retail sales rose only 0.4% year‑on‑year, fixed‑asset investment growth slowed to 7.2% this year, and industrial production remains strong.

On Wednesday, Indonesia’s central bank will announce its latest rate decision, with markets expecting the policy rate to stay unchanged at 5.75%. DBS economists note that the newly appointed governor Destry Damayanti may stress that a tightening global financial environment and geopolitical tensions are the main risks, while also pointing out that Indonesia’s economy remains relatively resilient.

ING economists Deepali Bhargava and Lynn Song say that after the dovish pause in August and recent foreign‑capital inflows that have helped the rupiah appreciate, the central bank is likely to hold steady, though there is a chance of a 0.25‑percentage‑point hike in Q4.

On the same day, the South African Reserve Bank may raise its rate by one basis point to 7.25% due to concerns that recent oil‑price spikes could push inflation higher. HSBC economists argue that the short‑term inflation lift from higher oil, divergent inflation expectations and synchronized rate hikes in advanced economies all give the SARB ample reason to tighten monetary policy.
3. Trump‑Xi summit

Following the May summit in Beijing, Chinese President Xi Jinping will travel to Washington on Thursday (the 24th) for his first White House visit in a decade, meeting U.S. President Donald Trump. In addition to discussions on Taiwan and Iran, the backdrop is delicate: China’s trade surplus is set to exceed $1 trillion for a second consecutive year, while Trump is busy dealing with the war in Iran and the upcoming mid‑term elections.

items.title: 胡塞嗆沙國升級行動將遭更強反擊！利雅德急向多國求援  專家：中東油運波動率短期下不來
items.title_en: Houthis Warn Saudi Arabia That Upgraded Actions Will Meet Stronger Counterattack! Riyadh Urgently Seeks Aid from Multiple Nations; Experts: Middle‑East Oil‑Transport Volatility Won’t Ease in the Short Term
paras: 葉門胡塞武裝發言人奧馬爾·巴希提周日(20日)表示，如果沙烏地阿拉伯繼續對葉門採取軍事升級行動，葉門胡塞武裝將採取更強烈的反擊。他並指責沙國持續發動軍事行動，並稱這造成葉門人員傷亡和「主權受到侵犯」。巴希提同時指控沙國試圖在葉門首都薩那實施針對平民的爆炸攻擊，稱這是「針對平民的暴力行為」。
葉門胡塞武裝組織周六(19日)宣布對沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅德「敏感目標」，以及紅海延布沙烏地阿美設施發動兩次行動，使用彈道飛彈、巡弋飛彈和無人機，以沙國為首聯軍稱凌晨攔截一枚射向利雅德的彈道飛彈，並挫敗對塔伊夫、比什、費爾桑、延布等地的多起空襲。
同日，美國駐伊拉克、沙國、巴林、阿曼、卡達、科威特、約旦等多國使館發布安全警示，稱胡塞與沙國衝突可能「迅速升級」，建議美國公民保持警惕並預備航班取消、空域關閉等旅行中斷。
自7月本輪葉門衝突升級以來，沙國首都首次拉響防空警報，哈立德國王機場附近一度冒煙，標誌著紅海—阿拉伯半島能源通道風險從「邊境襲擾」抬升至「首都+煉化雙目標」。
風險核心是「雙峽鎖喉」。荷姆茲海峽受伊朗相關封鎖與通行限制，沙國為繞過波斯灣風險，把部分原油經東西管道輸至紅海延布外運，但胡塞近期奪佔紅海穆哈、丕林島等據點，擴大對曼德海峽及週邊航線的打擊與封鎖， 又持續攻擊延布、東西管道相關設施。
多家航運業者與媒體報導指出，延布替代出口受限，波斯灣—紅海「雙出口」同時承壓。 胡塞表態稱「以封鎖對封鎖、以升級對升級」，目標包括沙國相關船舶與紅海能源基礎設施， 曼德作為荷姆茲替代線的緩衝價值被明顯削弱。
運價已反映極端風險。根據波羅的海交易所上周五數據，中東灣—中國TD3C超大型油輪(VLCC)日租金約124.1萬美元；Gibson稱該水準「前所未有」。大西洋方面，西非—中國TD15往返TCE一天約52.7萬美元，墨西哥灣—中國TD22約40萬美元。
Trafigura首席經濟學家Saad Rahim指出，將原油運至各地成本「從未如此之高」。高運費倒逼煉油廠放棄遠途、搶近端貨源；部分中東貨轉向阿曼灣短駁、好望角或蘇伊士—地中海繞行，運距從20餘天拉至50餘天，戰爭險同步重定價。
Gibson提示，超高運價本身會觸發需求破壞與船型替代，但短期「中斷主導」難解。
沙國正陷入彈藥與盟友協調雙重缺口。官員披露，已向法國、英國、巴基斯坦、埃及請求防空支援，另有日媒稱沙國向未建交的以色列罕見尋求協助；求援背景是美國因伊朗戰事消耗攔截彈、不願直接空襲胡塞。
有報導指出，美國總統川普拒絕沙國空襲請求，僅由美軍中央司令部加強情報共享與規劃支援。
上月簽署的《麥加共同防務協議》把對沙國、土耳其、巴基斯坦任一國的武裝攻擊視為對全體攻擊； 巴國軍方稱「不惜一切」提供外交與實質支持，土耳其外長費丹承諾軍事技術援助，並強調沙國不應被拖入美伊衝突，但兩國均未給出具體駐防、彈幕或實戰部署方案。 協議尚待國內批准、兵力結構與戰區責任劃分清晰化，短期更偏外交嚇阻而非即時補防。

中東局勢後續看三變量：其一，胡塞是否續打利雅德機場、延布裝船泵站與東西管道節點，若持續，沙特紅海出口恢復將後延；其二，曼德海峽實際通行量，Kpler等機構數據若顯示沙國關聯油輪進一步改道，TD3C與替代航線運費用易穩降；其三，麥加協議是否從美國數據升級為廣泛控制。目前市場定價已包含「首都遇襲+雙峽受限」的尾部風險，任何解除警報、管線恢復、增強護航的消息都會觸發運價回吐，但在胡塞控制紅海關鍵據點、沙國攔截彈庫存偏緊前，油運與中東風險溢價仍處數十年來高位區間。
paras_en: Yemen’s Houthi spokesperson Omar Bahtiti said on Sunday (the 20th) that if Saudi Arabia continues to step up its military actions against Yemen, the Houthis will respond with even stronger retaliation. He blamed Saudi Arabia for ongoing military operations that have caused Yemeni casualties and “violated sovereignty,” and accused the kingdom of attempting civilian‑targeted bomb attacks in the capital Sana’a, calling them “violence against civilians.”

The Houthi organization announced on Saturday (the 19th) that it had carried out two operations against “sensitive targets” in Saudi Arabia’s capital Riyadh and against Saudi Aramco facilities in Yanbu on the Red Sea, using ballistic missiles, cruise missiles and drones. The Saudi‑led coalition said it intercepted a ballistic missile aimed at Riyadh in the early hours and foiled multiple air strikes on Taif, Bish, Faisal and Yanbu.

On the same day, U.S. embassies in Iraq, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Oman, Qatar, Kuwait and Jordan issued safety alerts warning that the Houthi‑Saudi clash could “escalate rapidly,” urging U.S. citizens to stay alert and be prepared for flight cancellations, air‑space closures and other travel disruptions.

Since the July escalation of the Yemen conflict, Saudi Arabia sounded an air‑defence alert over its capital for the first time, and smoke was seen near King Khalid International Airport, marking a shift in risk on the Red Sea‑Arabian Peninsula energy corridor from “border skirmishes” to “capital plus refinery dual targets.”

The core risk is the “dual‑strait choke‑point.” The Hormuz Strait is subject to Iranian‑related closures and passage limits; Saudi Arabia, to bypass Persian Gulf risks, routes part of its crude through east‑west pipelines to Yanbu for export, but the Houthis have recently seized Red Sea outposts such as Muha and Pearl Island, expanding attacks and blockades on the Mandeb Strait and surrounding lanes, and continue striking Yanbu and east‑west pipeline facilities.

Several shipping firms and media report that the Yanbu alternative export route is now constrained, putting pressure on the “dual‑export” system of the Persian Gulf‑Red Sea. The Houthis state they will “blockade the blockade, upgrade the upgrade,” targeting Saudi‑linked vessels and Red Sea energy infrastructure, and the Mandeb’s value as a Hormuz‑alternative buffer has been markedly reduced.

Freight rates already reflect the extreme risk. Baltic Exchange data from last Friday showed that the daily hire for a VLCC on the Middle East‑China TD3C route was about $1.241 million; Gibson called the level “unprecedented.” In the Atlantic, the West Africa‑China TD15 round‑trip TCE was about $527,000 per day, and the Gulf of Mexico‑China TD22 about $400,000 per day.

Trafigura chief economist Saad Rahim said the cost of moving crude to markets has “never been this high.” The high freight charges are forcing refineries to abandon long‑haul supplies and chase nearer cargoes; some Middle‑East cargoes are being rerouted via the Oman Bay short‑leg, the Cape of Good Hope or the Suez‑Mediterranean loop, extending voyages from just over 20 days to more than 50 days, with war‑risk premiums being re‑priced simultaneously.
Gibson warned that ultra‑high freight rates themselves can trigger demand destruction and vessel‑type substitution, but in the short term a “disruption‑driven” market remains hard to resolve.

Saudi Arabia is facing a dual shortfall of ammunition and allied coordination. Officials disclosed that they have asked France, the United Kingdom, Pakistan and Egypt for air‑defence support, and Japanese media reported that Saudi Arabia has unusually sought assistance from Israel, with which it has no diplomatic ties; the backdrop is that the United States, busy intercepting Iranian‑related missiles, is reluctant to conduct direct air strikes against the Houthis.

Reports indicate that former U.S. President Donald Trump rejected Saudi Arabia’s request for air strikes, limiting U.S. involvement to enhanced intelligence sharing and planning support from Central Command.

The “Mecca Joint Defense Agreement” signed last month treats an armed attack on any of Saudi Arabia, Turkey or Pakistan as an attack on all parties. Pakistan’s military said it would provide “unconditional” diplomatic and material support, Turkey’s foreign minister Fidan pledged military‑technical aid and stressed that Saudi Arabia should not be dragged into the U.S.–Iran conflict, though neither country has offered concrete troop deployments, artillery or combat‑ready plans. The pact still awaits domestic ratification and clarification of force structures and theater responsibilities, and in the short term leans more toward diplomatic deterrence than immediate reinforcement.

Future developments in the Middle East hinge on three variables: first, whether the Houthis continue striking Riyadh’s airport, Yanbu’s loading pumps and the east‑west pipeline nodes; sustained attacks would further delay the recovery of Saudi Red Sea exports. Second, the actual traffic through the Mandeb Strait; if data from Kpler and others show Saudi‑linked tankers rerouting, VLCC and alternative‑route freight rates could ease. Third, whether the Mecca pact escalates from a U.S.‑data‑driven framework to broader control. Market pricing already embeds the tail‑risk of “capital under attack plus dual‑strait constraints”; any news of alert lifts, pipeline restorations or enhanced escort services would trigger freight‑rate pull‑backs, but as long as the Houthis control key Red Sea points and Saudi missile‑intercept stocks remain tight, oil‑transport and Middle‑East risk premiums stay at multi‑decade highs.
